Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 8:
Yesh ishsha sheyyesh lah veset veyesh ishsha sheen lah veset ella lo targish beatzmah ad sheyyetze haddam veen lah yom kavua liriyyatah. vezehu sheyyesh lah veset hi sheyyesh lah yom kavua. o meesrim yom leesrim yom. o michd yom lechd yom. o pachot o yoter: 
Vekodem sheyyavo haddam targish beatzmah. mefaheket umitatteshet vechosheshet pi keresah veshippule meeha veyistammer saarat besarah o yecham besarah vechayyotze bimoraot ellu. veyavou lah vesatot ellu o echad mehen beshaa hakkevua lah miyyom vestah: 
Kevar bearnu shekkol ishsha sheen lah veset asura leshammesh ad shettivdok atzmah techilla. vesheyyesh lah veset asura leshammesh bechol onat havveset. im vestah bayyom asura leshammesh kol oto hayyom. veim vestah ballayla asura leshammesh kol oto hallayla. umittechillat yom havveset tispor yeme niddatah vime zivatah leolam: 
Lefichach tzerichot hannashim lehizzaher bivsatot ad shetteda hayyom vehashshaa shennikbea bah vestah. haya darkah lirot beyom esrim uva yom esrim velo raata uva yom shelosha veesrim veraata hare yom esrim veyom shelosha veesrim shenehen asurin. vechen im raata paam sheniyya beyom 23 velo raata beyom esrim adayin shenehen asurin. raata paam shelishit beyom shelosha veesrim velo raata beyom esrim tahar yom esrim veneekar havveset leyom shelosha veesrim. sheen haishsha kovaat veset ad shettikbaennu shalosh peamim. veenah mittaheret min havveset ad shetteaker mimmenna shalosh peamim: 
Kol veset shennikba mechamat ones afillu raata bo kamma peamim eno veset shemmippene haones raata. kaftza veraata kaftza veraata kava lah veset leyamim belo kefitzot. ketzad. kaftza beechad beshabbat veraata dam. uleachar esrim yom kaftza beechad beshabbat veraata dam. uleachar 19 kaftza beyom hashshabbat velo raata dam uleachar shabbat raata belo kefitza. hare nikba echad beshabbat achar esrim. shehare noda shehayyom garam lah lirot velo hakkefitza. uchevar nikba yom ze shalosh peamim. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Raata yom 15 bechodesh ze veyom 16 bechodesh shel acharav veyom 17 bechodesh shel acharav veyom 18 lechodesh shel acharav hare kava lah veset ledillug. ba chodesh revii veraata beyom 17 adayin lo nikba lah veset. vechol yom sheraata bo chosheshet lo lehabba. kevan sheyyaggia oto hayyom velo tire tahar oto hayyom min havveset sheen tzarich akirat shalosh peamim ella yom shennikba shalosh peamim: 
Haya darkah lihyot roa yom 15 veshinneta letz shenehem asurin. shinneta leyz huttar 16 veneesar 17 vetv beissuro omed. shinneta leych neesar 18 vehutteru kullam: 
Haya darkah lirot yom esrim veshinneta leyom 22 shenehem asurin. higgia esrim velo raata 22 veraata adayin shenehen asurin. higgia yom esrim veraata tahar yom 22. shehare chazra levestah hakkavua veneekar 22 mippene shello nikba shalosh peamim: 
En haishsha kovaat lah veset betoch yeme niddatah sheraata bahen. kevan sheraata yom echad enah kovaat lah veset bechol hashshiva. vechen en haishsha kovaat veset bime zivatah shehen achad asar yom. aval kovaat hi veset bime niddatah sheenah roa bahen. veim nikba lah veset bime zivatah hare zo chosheshet levestah. vechol veset shekkava bime zivatah im neekra afillu paam achat neekra veenah tzericha leheaker shalosh peamim shechezkat damim mesullakin hen leyamim ellu: 
Ketzad chosheshet leveset. im raata dam beveset zo afillu yom echad teshev leniddatah missafek vaasura leshammesh beoto hayyom. vaafillu lo raata bishar yeme havvesatot. veim raata shelosha yamim hare zo zava: 
Kol ishsha shemmarba livdok atzmah tamid hare zo meshubbachat veaf al pi sheyyesh lah veset kevua. sheefshar sheyyavo dam belo sheat havveset. vechol 11 yom shel yeme zivatah hare hi bahen bechezkat tohora veenah tzericha bedika. aval achar yeme zivatah tzericha livdok: 
Shachcha velo badka ben beones ben beratzon hare zo bechezkat tohora ad shettivdok vetimmatze temea: 
Haishsha shello badka atzmah bishat vestah uleachar yamim badka umatza tame af al pi shehi temea lemafrea ad sheat vestah kemo sheyyitbaer beinyan tuma vetohora. hare zo enah metammea et boalah lemafrea. veenah mona ella mishshaa sheraata dam. veim matza atzmah tehora hare zo bechezkat tehora: 
Vechen ishsha sheraata dam mechamat makka sheyyesh lah bammakor af al pi sheraata bishat vestah hi tehora vehaddam tahor. shehavvesatot middivrehem kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot metammee mishkav umoshav: 
Hassuma bodeket atzmah umara lachavertah. aval hachereshet vehashshota tzerichot pikchot livdok otan velikboa lahen vesatot veachar kach yihyu muttarot levalehen: 
Kol ishsha shettaata velo yada et vestah veraata dam chosheshet lezivut. lefichach im raata yom echad o shenayim yoshevet tashlum shiva shemma dam ze bime niddatah hi. veim raata shelosha yamim soferet shivat yamim nekiyyim shemma bime zivatah hi omedet: 
Vechetzad hi osa letakken vestah veleda im hi zava vaddait o sefek zava veleda yeme zivatah. hakkol lefi yamim shettire bahen. ketzad. raata yom echad o shenayim mashlemet alehen hashshiva vetatchil limnot haachad asar yom meachar hashshiva: 
Raata shelosha yamim hare zo sefek zava shemma yom echad mehen kodem niddatah ushenayim bitchillat hannidda. vechen im raata arbaa shemma shenayim kodem hannidda ushenayim mittechillat hannidda veyoshevet chamishsha tashlum yeme nidda veachad asar yeme ziva achar hachamishsha: 
Vechen im raata tisha yamim hare zo sefek zava shemma shenayim kodem yeme nidda veshiva shel nidda umatchelet limnot achad asar yom meachar hattisha sheppasak haddam. vechen im raata achad asar yom hare zo sefek zava. shemma shenayim kodem hannidda veshiva shel nidda ushenayim shel achar hannidda venishar lah mime zivatah tisha: 
Raata shenem asar yom hare zo zava vaddait. sheafillu hayu mehen shenayim lifne hannidda veshiva shel nidda hare shelosha leachar hannidda veyishshaer lah mime zivatah shemona. vechen im raata shelosha asar yom yishshaer lah mime zivatah shiva vehen yeme hassefira: 
Mashcha biriyyat haddam afillu raata elef yom kesheyyifsok haddam soferet shivat yamim nekiyyim. veachar hashshiva yatchilu yeme hannidda lezo shettaata: 
Hinne lamadta shekkol hattoa enah mona mishsheyyifsok haddam pachot mishshiva velo yoter al 17 veyavou yeme niddatah. ketzad. raata yom echad ufasak haddam mona 17 shishsha letashlum niddatah vey yeme zivatah veyavou yeme niddatah. veim raata 13 o yeter mona shiva mishsheyyifsok haddam veyavou yeme niddatah kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 9: En haishsha mittammea min hattora benidda o beziva ad shettargish vetire dam veyetze bivsarah kemo shebbearnu vetihye temea meet shettire ulehabba bilvad. veim lo hirgisha uvadka umatza haddam lefanim bapperozdor hare ze bechezkat shebba beharegasha kemo shebbearnu:

Umiddivre sofrim shekkol haroa ketem dam al besarah o al begadeha af al pi shello hirgisha af al pi shebbadka atzmah velo matza dam hare zo temea ucheillu matza dam lefanim bivsarah. vetuma zo besafek shemma ketem ze middam hacheder ba:

Vechen middivre sofrim shekkol haroa dam belo et vestah vechol haroa ketem temea lemafrea ad 24 shaot. veim badka betoch zeman ze umatza tahor temea lemafrea ad zeman bedika. veaf al pi shehi temea lemafrea middivrehem enah metammea et boalah lemafrea kemo shebbearnu. veenah mona leniddatah o lechitmah ella meet shettire haddam o shemmatza hakketem. vechol haroa ketem hare zo mekulkelet (leminyanah) shemma min hacheder ba venitkalkela vestah:

Haroa dam bishat vestah enah metammea lemafrea ella bishatah bilvad. vechen meubberet umenika betula uzekena dayyan sheatan veenan metammeot lemafrea. ezo hi meubberet. mishsheyyukkar ubbarah. vehu shelosha chodashim. menika kol 24 chodesh afillu met benah o gemalattu o netanattu lemenika:

Betula kol shello raata dam miyyameha af al pi sheraata mechamat nissuin o mechamat leda. zekena kol sheavru aleha tishim yom samuch leziknatah. vee zo hi zekena kol shekkorin lah zekena veenah makpedet. meubberet umenika uzekena kitman kiriyyatan veeno metamme lemafrea. betula shello raata dam miyyameha vaadayin hi ketanna kitmah tahor ad shettire dam shalosh vesatot:

Ma ben ketem hannimtza al besarah lechetem hannimtza al bigdah. shehakketem hannimtza al besarah en lo shiur. vehannimtza al habbeged eno metamme ad sheyyihye kigris hakkilki shehu merubba sheyyesh bo kede tesha adashot shalosh al shalosh. haya pachot mishshiur ze tahor. nimtza tippin tippin en mitztarfot. haya aroch hare ze mitztaref:

Ketem shennimtza al davar sheeno mekabbel tuma tahor veenah chosheshet lo. ketzad. yashva al kele avanim kele adama uchele gelalim o al or haddag o al keli cheres miggabbo o al beged sheen bo shalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot venimtza alehen dam tehora. afillu badka hakkarka veyashva aleha venimtza ketem al hakkarka kesheamda hare zo tehora. shekkol sheeno mekabbel tuma lo gazru al ketem sheyyimmatze bo. velo bimkabbel tuma ella im ken haya lavan. aval kele tzivonin en choshshin lechetem hannimtza bahen. lefichach tikkenu chachamim shettilbash haishsha bigde tzivonin kede lehatztzilah middin hakketamim:

Lo bechol makom shennimtza haddam al besarah titma mishshum ketem ad sheyyimmatze keneged bet hatturpa. ketzad. nimtza al akevah temea shemma naga bevet turpa beet yeshivatah. vechen im nimtza al shokah o al parsoteha mibbifnim vehem hammekomot hannidbakot zo bezo beet shettaamod vetidbok regel leregel veshok leshok hare zo temea. nimtza al rosh gudal raglah temea shemma nataf min hacheder al raglah beet shehalcha. vechen kol makom sheefshar sheyyinnatez alav dam niddatah keshettehallech venimtza sham dam temea. vechen im nimtza haddam al yadeha afillu al kishre etzbeot yadeha temea shehayyadayim askaniyyot hen. aval im nimtza haddam al shokah veal parsoteha mibbachutz o min hatztzedadin veen tzarich lomar im nimtza min hayerechayim ulemala hare zo tehora sheen ze ella dam shennittaz aleha mimmakom acher:

Hakketem hannimtza al besarah shehu aroch kirtzua o agol. o shehayu tippin tippin. o shehaya orech hakketem al rochav yerechah. o shehaya nire keillu hu mimmatta lemala. hoil vehu keneged bet turpa hare zo temea. veen omrim illu nataf min hagguf lo haya kaze. shekkol dam hannimtza bimkomot ellu machamirin bo af al pi shehu safek:
Hakketem hannimtza al hechaluk shellah mechagorah ulematta temea mechagorah ulemala tehora. nimtza al bet yad shellah im maggia keneged bet turpa temea veim lav tehora:
Hayta poshatto umitkassa bo ballayla kol makom sheyyimmatze bo dam temea. vechen haezor shellah kol makom sheyyimmatze bo haddam temea:

Hayta loveshet chaluk echad veshaha aleha shelosha yamim o yeter belo et niddatah uvadka umatza alav shelosha ketamim o ketem echad gadol sheyyesh bo shiur shelosha ketamim hare zo sefek zava shemma ketem nataf mimmenna bechol yom. vechen im lavsha shelosha begadim bedukim veshahu aleha shelosha yamim bime zivatah umatza ketem bechol echad mehen af al pi shezze keneged ze hare zo sefek zava:

Matza ketem echad sheen bo kede shelosha ketamim im badka atzmah kol ben hashshemashot shel yom rishon umatza tahor velo badka chalukah uvayyom hashshelishi matza ze hakketem sheeno kishlosha ketamim enah chosheshet lezivut. veim lo badka atzmah kol ben hashshemashot hoil velo badka chalukah veshaha aleha shelosha yamim bime zivatah chosheshet lezivut veaf al pi sheen hakketem kede shelosha ketamim:
Matza ketem al chalukah hayyom veraata dam achar kach shene yamim ze achar ze. o sheraata shene yamim uvayyom hashshelishi raata ketem. hare zo sefek zava:

Haroa ketem veachar kach raata dam tola kitmah biriyyatah kol meet leet. ben shebbadka atzmah beet shemmatza hakketem umetzatah tahor. ben shello badka. aval haroa ketem achar ketem betoch esrim vearba shaot enah tola ketem bakketem ella im ken badka benehem. sheim hifsika tohora ben hakketamim en mitztarfin leminyan zivut:

Ketzad. raata ketem erev shabbat beshaa rishona min hayyom af al pi shello badka atzmah velo yada im tehora hi im temea veraata dam achar kach ad shaa rishona miyyom hashshabbat enah mona lakketem. ella tola hakketem biriyya. veim raata beechad beshabbat uvesheni beshabbat tihye zava. raata dam beyom shabbat beshaa sheniyya hare zo temea shene yamim erev shabbat shemmatza bo hakketem uveshabbat sheraata haddam shehare en shenehem betoch meet leet. veim raata haddam beechad beshabbat choshshin lezivut:

Lo raata dam beshabbat aval raata ketem acher beshaa rishona miyyom hashshabbat. im badka atzmah beerev shabbat umatza tahor enah mona ella lechetem echad shehu beyom hashshabbat hoil ushenehem betoch meet leet. veim lo badka velo yada im hifsika tohora benehen im lo hifsika hare zo mona leerev shabbat veim raata beechad beshabbat chosheshet lezivut:

Raata hakketem hashsheni beshaa sheniyya miyyom shabbat ben badka ben lo badka hare zo temea shene yamim shehare en shenehem betoch meet leet. veim raata beechad beshabbat achar meet leet chosheshet lezivut. raata beshaa rishona miyyom echad beshabbat ketem shelishi im hifsika tohora benehen en mitztarfin veenah chosheshet lezivut. veim lo badka chosheshet lezivut:

Kol ketem sheamarnu shehi temea biglalo im yesh lah davar litlot bo velomar shemma ketem ze middavar peloni hu im nimtza al habbeged hare zo tehora. shello amru chachamim baddavar lehachamir ella lehakel. veim nimtza al besarah sefeko tame veenah tola bo. veim haya lah litlot bivsarah yeter mechalukah af al besarah tola usefeko tahor:

Ketzad. shachata behema o chayya o of o shennitasseka bichtamim o sheyyashva betzad haoskin bahen o sheavra beshuk shel tabbachim venimtza dam al chalukah tehora vetola bidvarim ellu shemmehen ba hakketem:

Nimtza hakketem al besarah bilvad im hakketem mechagor ulematta temea. veim nithappecha vekaftza afillu mechagor ulemala temea sheillu haya dam ze min hashshechita o min hashshuk haya lah sheyyimmatze gam al begadeha vehoil venimtza al besarah velo bevigdah temea:
Hayta bah makka af al pi shechayta im yechola lehitgalla ulehotzi dam venimtza dam al besarah tola bammakka. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Nimtza hakketem al begadeha uvesarah keechad tola bechol sheyyesh lah litlot. vetola bemaacholet shemma beet sheyyashva neherga maacholet vedam ze dam maacholet hu. vead kamma ad kigris. aval im matza hakketem yeter mikkigris enah tola bemaacholet vaafillu hayta maacholet retzutza bakketem hoil vehu yeter mikkigris enah tola bemaacholet:
Vechen tola bivnah uvevalah im hayu asukin bedam o shehayu yedehen meluchlachot o shehayta bahen makka tola bahen veomeret hen nagu bah vehi lo yada vedam ze mechamatan hu:

En machazikin dam mimmakom lemakom litlot bo. ketzad. hayta lah makka bichtefah venimtza ketem al shokah. en omrin shemma beyadeha naga bammakka venaga bemakom ze. vechen kol kayyotze baze en tolin bo ben begufah ben bachalukah:

Shete nashim shennitasseku betzippor echad veen bo ella kesela dam venimtza al kol achat mishshetehen ketem kesela shetehen temeot. nitasseka bedam shei efshar sheyyihye mimmennu ketem ella kigris venimtza aleha ketem kishne gerisin hare zo tola kigris baddam shennitasseka bo vechigris bemaacholet. nimtza hakketem yeter mikkishne gerisin temea:

Nitasseka beadom en tola bo shachor. nitasseka beof sheyyesh bo mine dam harebe venimtza aleha mare echad mehen tola bo. hayta loveshet shelosha chalukot im yechola litlot tola af battachton. veim enah yechola litlot enah tola af baelyon. ketzad. avra beshuk shel tabbachim af al pi shennimtza hakketem al hattachton levaddo tola bedam hattabbachim. lo avra beshuk hattabbachim vechayyotze bo af al pi shennimtza hakketem baelyon levaddo hare zo temea safek avra safek lo avra safek nitasseka safek lo nitasseka enah tola:
Ir sheyyesh bah chazirim o shehem bain lah tamid en choshshin lichtameha hannimtzain bachalukah:

Haishsha shehishila chalukah lenidda ben akkum ben yisreelit vechazra velavsha oto kodem bedika umatza alav ketem hare zo tola bannidda shellavsha oto. hishila oto lezava ketanna bayyom hattame shellah o layyoshevet al dam tohar o livtula sheddameha tehorin hare zo tola bah. aval im hishila oto lezava ketanna bayyom hashshamur o lezava gedola beshiva yamim nekiyyim vechazra velavsha oto kodem bedika venimtza alav ketem shetehen mekulkalot hashshoelet vehammashelet otah shemma mizzo shemma mizzo. hishila oto leyoshevet al hakketem enah tola bah sheen tolin ketem bechetem:

Badka chalukah uvadka atzmah umatza tahor vehishila hechaluk lachavertah ulevashattu venimtza alav ketem keshehechezirato lah hashshoelet temea. veenah tola bevaalat hechaluk shehare badka oto kodem shettashilehu lah:
Arukka shellavsha chalukah shel ketzara venimtza bo ketem im maggia keneged bet hatturpa temea veim lav tehora. shekketem ze shel ketzara hu:

Shalosh nashim shellavshu chaluk echad zo achar zo veachar kach nimtza alav ketem. vechen im yeshenot bemitta achat keachat venimtza dam tachat achat mehen kullan temeot. veim badka achat mehen atzmah miyyad umatza atzmah temea hare hashshetayim tehorot:

Badku kullan umatzu atzman tehorot tola mi sheenah reuya lirot dam bemi shehi reuya. vetihye sheenah reuya tehora veharuya temea. ketzad. hayta achat meubberet veachat enah meubberet hameubberet tehora vesheenah meubberet temea. menika vesheenah menika hammenika tehora. zekena vesheenah zekena hazzekena tehora. betula vesheenah betula habbetula tehora. hayu kullan meubbarot kullan zekenot kullan menikot kullan betulot hare kullan temeot:

Shalosh nashim shealu derech margelot hammitta veyashnu kullan venimtza dam tachat haemtzait shelashtan temeot. tachat happenimit hi veshebbetziddah temeot vehachitzona tehora. tachat hachitzona hi veshebbetziddah temeot vehappenimit tehora. veim lo alu derech margelot hammitta shehare en lahem seder venimtza dam tachat achat mehen kullan temeot:

Bamme devarim amurim shebbadku kullan umatzu tahor velo tuchal achat mehen litlot bachavertah kemo shebbearnu. aval im badka achat umatza atzmah tehora vachavertah lo badka tola hattehora bezo shello badka vahare zo shello badka temea:

Kol ketem shennimtza al habbeged sheen lah bema yitle eno metamme ad sheyyivvada shehu dam. veim nistappek lahem shemma hu dam o tzeva adom maavirin alav shiva sammanin ellu al hasseder. im avar o keha eno hare ze ketem dam utemea veim amad kemot shehu hare ze tzeva utehora:

Veellu hen hashshiva sammanim al sidran. rok tafel. uleisat gerisin shel pol. ume raglayim shehechemitzu. uvorit. veneter. vekimonya. veashlag. vetzarich lechaskes shalosh peamim al kol sam vesam umolich umevi bechol kiskus. heeviran shello al hasseder o sheheeviran keechad lo asa kelum. hikdim haacharonim larishonim ellu sheheevir baacharona shehen harishonim alu lo vechozer umaavir acharehem acharonim shehikdim ad sheyyaavru hashshiva al hasseder:

E zehu rok tafel shello taam kelum mittechillat hallayla vehaya yashen mechatzi hallayla haacharon lemachar kodem sheyyochal nikra rok tafel. vehu shello yatza rov dibburo ad shalosh shaot bayyom. veim hishkim veshana pirko kodem shalosh shaot en ze rok tafel shehaddibbur mevattel chozek harok umachaziro kemayim. vee zo hi leisat gerisin hu sheyyilos haggerisin ad sheyyitarev im happol rok harebe mippiv. vee zehu me raglayim shehechemitzu achar shelosha yamim o yeter:

Kol ishsha shehi temea mishshum ketem im matza hakketem bime niddatah hare zo sefek nidda veyoshevet alav shiva yamim vetovelet belel shemini veachar kach tihye mutteret levalah. veim matza oto bime zivatah hare zo sefek zava gedola o ketanna kemo shennitbaer beferek ze. veyoshevet yom echad im hayta ketanna o shivat yamim nekiyyim im hayta gedola missafek. vehakkol middivre sofrim kemo shebbearnu. lefichach habba aleha bezadon makkin oto makkat mardut ufeturin mikkarban:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 10: Kol yoledet temea kenidda veaf al pi shello raata dam. veechad hayyoledet chay o met o afillu nefel. im zachar yoshevet lezachar veim nekeva yoshevet linkeva vehu shettiggamer tzurato. veen tzurat havvalad nigmeret lefachot mearbaim yom echad hazzachar veechad hannekeva:

Vehammappelet betoch arbaim yom enah temea leda afillu beyom arbaim. hippila beyom arbaim veechad meachar hattashmish hare zo sefek yoledet veteshev lezachar velinkeva ulenidda. hayta tzurat haadam dakka beyoter veenah nikkeret baalil hare zo teshev lezachar velinkeva vezehu hannikra shappir merukkam:

E ze hu shappir merukkam. techillat beriyyato shel adam gufo kaadasha. shete enav kishte tippe zevuv meruchakot zo mizzo. shene chotamav kishte tippe zevuv mekoravot ze laze. piv patuach kechut hassaara. vechittuch yadayim veraglayim en lo. nitbaara tzurato yeter mizze vaadayin eno nikkar ben zachar linkeva en bodkin oto bemayim ella beshemen shehashshemen metzachtzecho. umevi kesam sherosho chalak umenanea beoto makom millemala lematta im mesachsech beyadua shehu zachar. veim raa oto makom kisora seduka hare zo nekeva veenah tzericha bedika. vechol ellu harkimot shel nefalim en notnin lahen yeme tohar ad sheyyasir havvalad:
Hippila chaticha levana im nikrea venimtza bah etzem hare zo temea leda. hippila shappir male mayim male dam male ginnunim male basar hoil veeno merukkam enah chosheshet levalad:

Yotze dofen en immo temea leda veen lah yeme tuma vime tohora shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 12 2)</small> "ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar" ad shetteled mimmakom shemmazraat. hammaksha veyalda valad derech haddofen hare dam hakkoshi habba derech harechem zivut o nidda vedam hayyotze derech haddofen tame. veim lo yatza dam derech harechem hare haishsha tehora. af al pi shehaddam sheyyatza middafnah tame. sheen haishsha temea ad sheyyetze madveha derech ervatah:

Nechtach havvalad bemeeha veyatza evar evar. ben sheyyatza al seder haevarim kegon sheyyatza haregel veachareha hashshok veachareha hayyarech. ben sheyyatza shello al hasseder enah temea leda ad sheyyetze rubbo. veim yatza rosho kullo keechad hare ze kerubbo. veim lo nechtach veyatza kedarko mishshettetze rov paddachto hare ze keyalud af al pi shennechtach achar kach:
Hotzi haubbar et yado vehechezirah immo temea leda middivre sofrim. veen lah yeme tohar ad sheyyetze havvalad kullo o rubbo kemo sheamarnu:

Hammappelet kemin behema chayya o of im hayu panav kifne adam hare ze valad. im zachar teshev lezachar veim nekeva teshev linkeva. veim eno nikkar ben zachar linkeva teshev lezachar velinkeva af al pi sheshshear hagguf dome livhema o lechayya o leof. veim en panav ketzurat pene haadam af al pi sheshshear hagguf guf adam shalem veyadav veraglav yede veragle adam vahare hu zachar o nekeva eno valad veen immo temea leda:

E zo hi tzurat pene haadam. sheyyihye hammetzach vehaggevinin vehaenayim vehallesatot vegabbot hazzakan ketzurat haadam. aval happe vehaaznayim vehaaf af al pi shehen keshel behema vechayya hare ze valad:

Hammappelet demut nachash immo temea leda mippene sheggalgal enav agol keshel adam. hammappelet demut adam sheyyesh lo kenafayim shel basar immo temea leda. nivra beayin achat veyarech achat im hayu min hatztzad hare hu kachatzi adam veimmo temea leda. veim hayu baemtza immo tehora shehare zo beriyya acheret:

Nivra veshet shello atum o shehaya chaser mittibburo ulematta vahare hu atum. o shehayta gulgalto atuma. o shehayu panav tuchot veen bahen hekker panim. o sheyyesh lo shene gabbin ushete shederot. o shehippila beriyyat rosh sheeno chatuch. o yad sheeno chatuch. kol nefel meellu eno valad veen immo temea leda. aval im hippila yad chatucha veregel chatucha hare chezkatah mivvalad shalem umitztarfin lerov evarav:

Peamim yikpe mishshear haddamim shennotzar mehem haadam chaticha kemo leshon hashshor vetihye kerucha al miktzat havvalad vehi hannikret sandal. uleolam lo yease sandal ze ella im valad. aval chaticha shennotzra levaddah belo valad enah nikret sandal. verov haubbarim lo yihye immahem sandal. ufeamim yakke hameubberet davar al bitnah veyippased haubbar veyease kesandal ze. ufeamim yishshaer bo hekker panim ufeamim yivash havvalad veyishtanne veyikpeu alav haddamim ad shello yishshaer bo hekker panim. lefichach hammappelet zachar vesandal immo af al pi sheen hekker panim lassandal hare zo teshev lezachar velinkeva shemma sandal ze nekeva haya. vechumra hechmiru bo letammeah bo mishshum valad af al pi sheen bo tzurat panim hoil vehi temea leda mippene havvalad sheimmo:

Hachotelet heava shehi kemo chemet shebbetochah notzar havvalad vehi makkefet oto veet hassandal im haya immo sandal uchesheyyaggia zemanno latzet korea otah veyotze hi hannikret shilya. utechillat beriyyatah doma lechut shel erev vachalula kachatzotzeret veava kekurkevan hattarnegolim. veen shilya pechuta mittefach:

Hammappelet shilya teshev lezachar velinkeva. lo shehashshilya valad ella sheen shilya belo valad. hippila nefel veachar kach hippila shilya choshshin lashshilya vahare hu kevalad acher veen omrin zo shilyat hannefel. sheen tolin et hashshilya ella bevalad shel kayyama. lefichach im yalda valad shel kayyama vehippila shilya afillu achar 23 yom tolin oto bavvalad veen choshshin levalad acher. shehavvalad kara hashshilya veyatza:

Hippila shilya techilla veachar kach yalda valad shel kayyama choshshin lashshilya shehi valad acher veen tolin otah bavvalad habba achareha. sheen darkah shel shilya latzet lifne havvalad. yatzat miktzat hashshilya bayyom harishon umiktzatah bashsheni monin lah miyyom harishon veen notnin lah yeme tohora ella miyyom sheni lehachamir:

Hippila demut behema chayya veof veshilya keshura bo en choshshin levalad. veim enah keshura bo metilin aleha chomer shete veladot sheani omer shemma nimmoach shappir merukkam shehaya beshilya zo veshemma nimmocha hashshilya shel shappir ze shehu demut behema vechayya:

Kol ellu shechoshshin leshilya en notnin lahen yeme tohar. vechol mi shehippila davar sheeno valad o shappir betoch arbaim yom sheadayin lo nigmera tzurato im yatza immo dam hare zo nidda o zava. veim yatza yavesh belo dam hare zo tehora:

Mi sheyyalda zachar unekeva teomim teshev linkeva. yalda tumtum o anderoginus teshev lezachar velinkeva. yalda teomim echad zachar vehashsheni tumtum o anderoginus teshev lezachar velinkeva. haachat nekeva vehashsheni tumtum o anderoginus teshev linkeva bilvad. shehattumtum vehaanderoginus safek hen shemma zachar hen shemma nekeva:

Haishsha shehuchzeka meubberet veyalda veen yadua ma yalda kegon sheavra lannahar vehippila sham o shehippila levor o shehippila ugerarattu chayya hare zo bechezkat shehippila valad veteshev lezachar velinkeva. aval im lo huchzeka meubberet vehippila veen yadua ma hippila hare ze sefek yoledet veteshev lezachar velinkeva ulenidda:

Kol makom shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 12 4)</small> "teshev" lezachar velinkeva ketzad dina. tihye asura levalah 14 yom keyoledet nekeva. shiva harishonim vadday. vehashshiva haacharonim safek. veen notnin lah yeme tohar ella ad arbaim yom keyoledet zachar. veim raata dam achar haarbaim ad shemonim eno dam tohar ella sefek dam nidda o sefek dam zivut im ba mime hazziva kemo shebbearnu. vechen im raata dam yom echad ushemonim bilvad hare zo sefek nidda veteshev shivat yeme hannidda shemma nekeva yalda sheen lah veset niddut ad achar melot kemo shebbearnu:

Kol makom shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 12 4)</small> "teshev" lezachar velinkeva ulenidda ketzad dina. tihye asura levalah 14 yom keyoledet nekeva. veim raata dam beyom echad ushemonim hare zo sefek nidda. vechen im raata beyom 74 uveyom 81 hare zo sefek nidda. vechen im raata beyom arbaim veechad af al pi sheraata beyom 34 hare zo sefek nidda vaasura levalah ad lel arbaim ushemona keyoledet zachar. veen notnin lah yeme tohar kelal kenidda. vahare hi kemi shello yalda. vechol dam shettire miyyom shehippila ad shemonim yom im ba bime niddatah hare zo sefek nidda meachar hashshiva miyyom shehippila. veim ba bime zivatah hare zo sefek zava shekkol yeme melot en bahen veset. vechen im raata beyom echad ushemonim adayin hi mekulkelet vetihye sefek nidda kemo shebbearnu af al pi shello raata ella yom echad uchesheyyikkava lah havveset achar hashshemonim yasur kilkulah vetachazor lihyot nidda vaddait o zava vaddait. vechen miyyom shehippila ad shiva yamim vetihye nidda vaddait im hippila betoch yeme niddatah kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 11: Kol sheamarnu benidda vezava veyoledet hu din tora. uchemishpatim ellu hayu osin keshehayu bet din haggadol metzuyin vehayu sham chachamim gedolim shemmakkirim haddamim veim nolad lahem safek biriyyot o bime nidda veziva yaalu levet din veyishalu kemo shehivticha tora alehen shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 8)</small> "ki yippale mimmecha davar lammishpat ben dam ledam ben din ledin", ben dam nidda ledam ziva. uveotan hayyamim hayu benot yisrael nizharot middavar ze umeshammerot vistotehen vesofrot tamid yeme hannidda vime hazziva:

Vetorach gadol yesh beminyan hayyamim ufeamim rabbot yavou lide safek. sheafillu raata habbat dam beyom halleda meoto hayyom matchilin limnot lah yeme nidda vime ziva kemo shebbearnu. ulefichach lo tittame habbat beziva ella bat asara yamim sheim raata bayyom shennolda hare zo nidda shivat yamim usheloshet yamim samuch leniddatah hare asara yamim. hinne lamadta shemmittechillat reiyya matchelet limnot yeme nidda vime ziva kol yameha vaafillu raata vehi ketanna:

Uvime chachme haggemara nistappek haddavar harebe biriyyat haddamim venitkalkelu havvesatot. lefi shello haya koach bechol hannashim limnot yeme nidda vime ziva. lefichach hechmiru chachamim bedavar ze vegazru sheyyehu kol yeme haishsha kime zivatah veyihye kol dam shettire sefek dam zivut:

Veod hechemiru benot yisrael al atzman chumra yetera al ze. venahagu kullam bechol makom sheyyesh yisrael shekkol bat yisrael sheroa dam afillu lo raata ella tippa kechardal bilvad ufasak haddam soferet lah shiva yamim nekiyyim vaafillu raata beet niddatah. ben sheraata yom echad o shenayim o hashshiva kullan o yeter mishsheyyifsok haddam soferet shivat yamim nekiyyim kezava gedola vetovelet belel shemini af al pi shehi sefek zava, o beyom shemini im haya sham dochak kemo sheamarnu. veachar kach tihye mutteret levalah:

Vechen kol hayyoledet bazzeman hazze hare hi keyoledet bezov utzericha shivat yamim nekiyyim kemo shebbearnu. uminhag pashut beshinar uveeretz hatztzevi uvisfarad uvammaarav sheim raata dam betoch yeme melot af al pi sheraata achar shessafra shivat yamim nekiyyim vetavla hare zo soferet shivat yamim nekiyyim achar sheyyifsok haddam veen notnin lah yeme tohar kelal. ella kol dam shettire haishsha ben dam koshi ben dam tohar hakkol tame vesoferet shivat yamim nekiyyim achar sheyyifsok haddam:

Vedin ze bime haggeonim nitchaddesh vehem gazru shello yihye sham dam tohar kelal. shezze shehechmiru al atzman bime chachme haggemara eno ella beroa dam shehu tame sheyyoshevet alav shiva nekiyyim. aval dam shettire bime tohar achar sefira utevila en lachush lo sheen yeme tohar reuyin lo lenidda velo leziva kemo shebbearnu:
Veshamanu shebbetzarfat boalim al dam tohar kedin haggemara ad hayyom achar sefira utevila mittumat yoledet bezov vedavar ze taluy bamminhag:

Vechen din dam betulim bazzeman hazze sheafillu hayta ketanna shello higgia zemanna lirot velo raata dam miyyameha boel beilat mitzva uforesh. vechol zeman shettire haddam mechamat hammakka hare hi temea. veachar sheyyifsok haddam soferet shiva yamim nekiyyim:

Yeter al ze kol bat shettevauha lehinnase veratzta shoha shivat yamim nekiyyim meachar sheratzta veachar kach tihye mutteret lehibbael. shemma mechimmudah leish raata dam tippa achat velo hirgisha bah. ben shehayta haishsha gedola ben shehayta ketanna tzericha leshev shiva nekiyyim meachar sheratzta veachar kach titbol vetibbael:

Vechol haddevarim haellu chumra yetera shennahagu bah benot yisrael mime chachme haggemara veen lasur mimmenna leolam. lefichach kol ishsha sheratzta keshettevauha lehinnase lo tinnase ad shettispor vetitbol veim nisset letalmid chacham mutteret lehinnase miyyad vetispor meachar shennesaattu vetitbol. shettalmid chacham yodea shehi asura venizhar mizze velo yikrav lah ad shettitbol:

Din hakketamim bazzeman hazze kemo shebbearnu veen baddavar chiddush velo minhag ella kol ketem sheamarnu shehi tehora hare hi tehora vechol ketem sheamarnu temea (im en bakketem shiur kede lachush lezivut) soferet shivat yamim miyyom shennimtza bo hakketem. veim haya shiur hakketem kede lachush lezivut soferet shivat yamim meachar yom shennimtza bo hakketem. sheen haroa dam keroa ketem:

Vechen kol ma sheamarnu beyoledet sheimmo tehora hare hi tehora bazzeman hazze. vechen haishsha sheraata loven o dam yarok o shehishlicha chaticha adumma sheen immah dam hare hi tehora af bazzeman hazze. shello hechmiru ella beroa dam tame [veen ze dam tame]:

Vechen im hayta bah makka vehaya haddam shotet mimmenna o shebba haddam im meme raglayim hare zo tehora. velo nitchaddesh davar ella sefirat shivat yamim nekiyyim lechol roa dam tame kemo sheamarnu vesheyyihyu kol mare damim temeim:

Ze shettimtza bemiktzat hammekomot shehannidda yoshevet shivat yamim beniddatah af al pi shello raata dam ella yom echad veachar hashshiva teshev shivat yamim nekiyyim en ze minhag ella taut hu mimmi shehora lahem kach veen rauy lifnot ledavar ze kelal ella im raata yom echad soferet acharav shiva (nekiyyim) vetovelet belel shemini shehu layil sheni shelleachar niddatah umutteret levalah:

Vechen ze shettimtza bemiktzat mekomot vetimtza teshuvot lemiktzat haggeonim sheyyoledet zachar lo teshammesh mittatah ad sof arbaim. veyoledet nekeva achar shemonim. veaf al pi shello raata dam ella betoch hashshiva. en ze minhag ella taut hu beotan hatteshuvot vederech eppikorosut beotan hammekomot umin hatztzedokin lamdu davar ze. umitzva lechofan kede lehotzi millibban ulehachaziran ledivre chachamim shettispor shiva yamim nekiyyim bilvad kemo shebbearnu:

En haishsha ola mittumatah veyotzet mide erva ad shettitbol beme mikve kasher. velo yihye davar chotzetz ben besarah uven hammayim. uvehilchot mikvaot yitbaer hammikve hakkasher vehappasul vederech hattevila umishpete hachatzitza. aval im rachatza bammerchatz afillu naflu aleha kol memot shebbaolam hare hi achar harchitza kemot shehayta kodem harchitza becharet. sheen lecha davar shemmaale mittuma letohora ella tevila beme mikve o bemaayan o bayyammim shehem kemaayan kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot mikvaot:

Kol shiva yamim nekiyyim shebbazzeman hazze af al pi shehen safek im tavla bahen keillu lo tavla. veim tavla bashshevii af al pi sheasur laasot ken lechattechilla shemma yavo livol bashshevii achar hattevila. hoil vetavla bizmannah afillu hayta zava vaddait hare zo alta lah tevila:

Veasur leadam sheyyidbak beishto beshivat yamim nekiyyim ellu veaf al pi shehi bichsutah vehu bichsuto. velo yikrav lah velo yigga bah afillu beetzba ketanna. velo yochal immah bikara achat. kelalo shel davar yinhog immah bime sefira kemo sheyyinhog bime nidda sheadayin hi becharet ad shettitbol kemo shebbearnu:

Kol melachot shehaishsha osa levalah nidda osa levalah chutz meharechatzat panav yadav veraglav umezigat hakkos vehatztzaat hammitta befanav. gezera shemma yavo lidvar avera. umippene ze lo tochal immo bikara achat velo yigga bivsarah mippene hergel avera. vechen beshivat yamim nekiyyim lo taase lo shalosh melachot ellu. umuttar leishsha lehitkashshet bime niddatah kede shello titganne al balah:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 12:
Yisrael shebbaal akkum mishshear haummot derech ishut. o yisreelit shennivala leakkum derech ishut hare ellu lokin min hattora shenneemar <small>(Devarim 7 3)</small> "lo titchatten bam bittecha lo titten livno uvitto lo tikkach livnecha". echad shiva amamin veechad kol ummot beissur ze. vechen meforash al yede ezra <small>(Nechemya 10 lo)</small> "vaasher lo nitten benotenu leamme haaretz veet benotehem lo nikkach levanenu": 
Velo asra tora ella derech chatnut aval habba al hakkutit derech zenut makkin oto makkat mardut middivre sofrim. gezera shemma yavo lehitchatten. veim yichadah lo biznut chayyav aleha mishshum nidda umishshum shifcha umishshum kutit umishshum zona. veim lo yichadah lo ella nikret mikre eno chayyav ella mishshum kutit [3.] vechol chiyyuvin ellu middivrehen: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshehaya habboel yisrael. aval kohen habba al hakkutit loke min hattora mishshum zona. veechad zona kutit veechad zona yisreelit. uvivila bilvad loke shehare enah bat kiddushin: 
Kol habboel kutit ben derech chatnut ben derech zenut im bealah befarhesya vehu sheyyivol leene asara miyyisrael o yeter im pagu bo kannain vaharaguhu hare ellu meshubbachin uzerizin [6.] vedavar ze halacha lemoshe missinay hu. reaya ledavar ze maase pinchas bezimri: 
Veen hakkannay rashshay lifgoa bahen ella bishat maase kezimri shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 25 8)</small> "veet haishsha el kovatah". aval im perash en horgin oto. veim harago neherag alav. veim ba hakkannay littol reshut mibbet din lehargo en morin lo veaf al pi shehu bishat maase. velo od ella im ba hakkannay laharog et habboel venishmat habboel veharag hakkannay kede lehatztzil atzmo miyyado en habboel neherag alav. vehabba al bat ger toshav en hakkannain pogim bo aval makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Lo pagu bo kannaim velo hilkuhu bayit din hare ansho meforash bedivre kabbala shehu becharet shenneemar <small>(Malachi 2 11)</small> "ki chillel yehuda kodesh Adonai asher ahev uvaal bat el nechar" <small>(Malachi 2 12)</small> "yachret Adonai laish asher yaasenna er veone". im yisrael hu lo yihye lo er bachachamim velo one battalmidim veim kohen hu lo yihye lo maggish mincha laAdonai tzevaot. hinne lamadta shehabboel kutit keillu nitchatten leakkum shenneemar "vaal bat el nechar venikra mechallel kodesh Adonai:" 
Avon ze af al pi sheen bo mitat bet din al yehi kal beenecha. ella yesh bo hefsed sheen bechol haarayot kemoto. shehabben min haerva beno hu lechol davar uvichlal yisrael nechshav af al pi shehu mamzer vehabben min hakkutit eno beno shenneemar <small>(Devarim 7 4)</small> "ki yasir et bincha meacharay" mesir oto millihyot achare Adonai: 
Vedavar ze gorem lehiddavek beakkum shehivdilanu hakkadosh baruch hu mehem velashuv meachare Adonai velimol bo: 
Akkum habba al bat yisrael im eshet ish hi neherag aleha veim penuya hi eno neherag: 
Aval yisrael habba al hakkutit ben ketanna bat shalosh shanim veyom echad ben gedola ben penuya ben eshet ish vaafillu haya katan ben tesha shanim veyom echad kevan shebba al hakkutit bezadon hare zo nehereget mippene shebba leyisrael takkala al yadeha kivhema. vedavar ze meforash battora shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar lo 16)</small> "hen henna hayu livne yisrael bidvar bilam" <small>(Bamidbar lo 17)</small> "vechol ishsha yodaat ish lemishkav zachar harogu": 
Haavadim shehitbilu otam leshem avdut vekibbelu alehem mitzvot shehaavadim chayyavim bahem yatzu mikkelal haakkum velichlal yisrael lo bau. lefichach hashshifcha asura leven chorin. echad shifchato veechad shifchat chavero. vehabba al hashshifcha makkin oto makkat mardut middivre sofrim. shehare meforash battora shehaadon noten shifcha kenaanit leavdo haivri vehi mutteret lo shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 4)</small> "im adonav yitten lo ishsha": 
Velo gazru chachamim bedavar ze velo chiyyeva tora malkot beshifcha ella im ken hayta necherefet leish kemo shebbearnu: 
Al yehi avon ze kal beenecha mippene sheen bo malkot min hattora. sheggam ze gorem labben lasur meachare Adonai. shehabben min hashshifcha hu eved veeno miyyisrael venimtza gorem lezera hakkodesh lehitchallel velihyotam avadim. hare unkelos hametargem kalal beilat eved veshifcha bichlal <small>(Devarim 23 18)</small> "lo yihye kadesh" <small>(Devarim 23 18)</small> "velo tihye kedesha": 
Habba al shifcha vaafillu befarhesya uvishat avera en hakkannain pogin bo. vechen im lakach shifcha derech chatnut eno loke min hattora. shemmeet shettavla vekibbela mitzvot yatzta mikkelal haakkum: 
Nitarev velad yisreelit bivlad shifcha hare shenehen safek vechol echad mehen sefek eved vechofin baal hashshifcha umeshachrer et shenehem. veim haya habben hahu (ben) haadon shel eved kesheyyigdelu yeshachreru ze et ze veyihyu muttarin lavo bakkahal: 
Hayu hattaarovot banot hare shetehen sefek shefachot vehabba al kol achat mehen havvalad sefek eved. vechen im nitarev velad akkum bivlad yisreelit matbilim et shenehen leshem gerut vechol achat mehen sefek giyyoret: 
Kol haakkum kullam kesheyyitgayyeru vikabbelu alehen kol hammitzvot shebbattora vehaavadim kesheyyishtachreru hare hen keyisrael lechol davar shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 15)</small> "hakkahal chukka achat yihye lachem". umuttarin lehikkanes bikhal Adonai miyyad. vehu sheyyissa hagger o hameshuchrar bat yisrael veyissa hayyisreeli giyyoret umeshuchreret. chutz mearbaa amamin bilvad vehem ammon umoav umitzrayim veedom shehaummot haellu kesheyyitgayyer echad mehen hare hu keyisrael lechol davar ella leinyan bia bakkahal: 
Vechetzad dinan. ammon umoav issuran issur olam zecharim velo nekevot shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 4)</small> "lo yavo ammoni umoavi bikhal Adonai" vegomer. halacha lemoshe missinay shehaammoni hazzachar vehammoavi hazzachar hu sheasur leolam lissa bat yisrael afillu ben beno ad sof haolam. aval ammonit umoavit mutteret miyyad kishar haummot: 
Mitzri veedomi echad zecharim veechad nekevot dor rishon vedor sheni asurin lavo beyisrael vedor shelishi muttar shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 9)</small> "banim asher yivvaldu lahem" vegomer: 
Mitzrit meubberet shennitgayyera benah sheni. mitzri sheni shennasa mitzrit rishona o mitzri rishon shennasa mitzrit sheniyya havvalad sheni shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 9)</small> "banim asher yivvaldu lahem" hakkatuv telaan beleda: 
Ger ammoni shennasa mitzrit havvalad ammoni. ger mitzri shennasa ammonit havvalad mitzri. ze hakkelal. baummot hallech achar hazzachar. nitgayyeru hallech achar happachut: 
Mi shennitgayyer mishshiva amamin enan asurin min hattora lavo bakkahal. vehaddavar yadua shello nitgayyeru mehen ella haggivonim vihoshua gazar alehem sheyyihyu asurim lavo bakkahal echad zecharim veechad nekevot. velo asar otam ella bizman sheyyesh mikdash shenneemar <small>(Yehoshua 9 23)</small> "vechotve etzim veshoave mayim levet elohay". tala harechakatam bammikdash: 
Vehem hannikraim netinim lefi shennetanam laavodat hammikdash. ba david vegazar alehem shello yikkansu bakkahal leolam vaafillu bizman sheen mikdash. vechen meforash beezra <small>(Ezra 8 20)</small> "umin hannetinim shennatan david vehassarim laavodat haleviyyim". ha lamadta shello tala otam bammikdash: 
Velamma gazar alehem hu uvet dino lefi sheraa azzut veachzariyyut shehayta bahem beet shebbikkeshu shivat bene shaul bechir Adonai litlotam vaharagum velo richamu alehem: 
Kesheala sancheriv melech ashshur bilbel kol haummot veervam ze baze vehigla otam mimmekomam. veellu hammitzrim shebbeeretz mitzrayim atta anashim acherim hem. vechen haedomim shebbisde edom. vehoil venitarvu arba ummot haasurim bechol ummot haolam shehen muttarim huttar hakkol. shekkol happoresh mehen lehitgayyer chezkato shepperash min harov. lefichach kesheyyitgayyer hagger bazzeman hazze bechol makom ben edomi ben mitzri ben ammoni ben moavi ben kushi ben shear haummot echad hazzecharim veechad hannekevot muttarin lavo bakkahal miyyad:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 13:
Vishlosha devarim nichnesu yisrael livrit. bemila utevila vekarban: 
Mila hayta bemitzrayim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 48)</small> "vechol arel lo yochal bo". mal otam moshe rabbenu shekkullam bittelu berit mila bemitzrayim chutz mishshevet levi veal ze neemar <small>(Devarim 33 9)</small> "uveritcha yintzoru": 
Utevila hayta bammidbar kodem mattan tora shenneemar <small>(Shemot 19 10)</small> "vekiddashtam hayyom umachar vechibbesu simlotam". vekarban shenneemar <small>(Shemot 24 5)</small> "vayyishlach et naare bene yisrael vayyaalu olot", al yede kol yisrael hikrivum: 
Vechen ledorot kesheyyirtze haakkum lehikkanes livrit ulehistofef tachat kanfe hashshechina vikabbel alav ol tora tzarich mila utevila veharetzaat karban. veim nekeva hi tevila vekarban shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 15)</small> "kachem kagger". ma attem bemila utevila veharetzaat karban af hagger ledorot bemila utevila veharetzaat karban: 
Umahu karban hagger. olat behema o shete torim o shene bene yona ushenehem ola. uvazzeman hazze sheen sham karban tzarich mila utevila uchesheyyibbane bet hammikdash yavi karban: 
Ger shemmal velo taval o taval velo mal eno ger ad sheyyamul veyitbol. vetzarich litbol bifne shelosha. vehoil vehaddavar tzarich bet din en matbilin oto beshabbat velo beyom tov velo ballayla. veim hitbiluhu hare ze ger: 
Ger katan matbilin oto al daat bet din shezzechut hi lo. meubberet shennitgayyera vetavla en benah tzarich tevila. taval beno leven atzmo venitgayyer beno leven atzmo vaafillu bifne shenayim eno ger. ba veamar nitgayyarti bevet dino shel peloni vehitbiluni eno neeman lavo bakkahal ad sheyyavi edim: 
Haya nasuy leyisreelit o legiyyoret veyesh lo banim veamar nitgayyarti beni leven atzmi neeman lifsol et atzmo veeno neeman lifsol et habbanim. vechozer vetovel bevet din: 
Giyyoret sherinuha noheget bedarche yisrael tamid kegon shettitbol leniddatah vetafrish teruma meissatah vechayyotze baze. vechen ger shennoheg bedarche yisrael shettovel lekiryo veose kol hammitzvot. hare ellu bechezkat gere tzedek. veaf al pi sheen sham edim shemmeidin lifne mi shennitgayyeru. veaf al pi chen im bau lehitarev beyisrael en massiin otam ad sheyyaviu edim o ad sheyyitbelu befanenu hoil vehuchzeku akkum: 
Aval mi shebba veamar shehaya akkum venitgayyer bevet din neeman. shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir. bamme devarim amurim beeretz yisrael uveotan hayyamim shechezkat hakkol sham bechezkat yisrael. aval bechutza laaretz tzarich lehavi reaya veachar kach yissa yisreelit. vaani omer shezzo maala beyuchasin: 
Keshem shemmalin umatbilin et haggerim kach malin umatbilin et haavadim hannilkachim min haakkum leshem avdut. hallokeach eved min haakkum vekadam haeved vetaval leshem ben chorin kana atzmo. vehu sheyyomar beet tevila hareni tovel bifnechem leshem gerut. veim taval bifne rabbo eno tzarich lefaresh ella kevan shettaval nishtachrer. lefichach tzarich rabbo letakpo bammayim ad sheyyaale vehu tachat shibudo umodio bifne haddayyanin shelleshem avdut matbilo. veen haeved tovel ella bifne shelosha uvayyom keger, shemmiktzat gerut hu: 
Kesheyyishtachrer haeved tzarich tevila acheret bifne shelosha bayyom shebbo tiggamer geruto veyihye keyisrael. veen tzarich lekabbel alav mitzvot ulehodio ikkere haddat shekkevar hodiuhu keshettaval leshem avdut: 
Uvemikve hakkasher litvilat nidda sham matbilin et haggerim veet haavadim veet hameshuchrarim. vechol davar shechotzetz benidda chotzetz begerim uvaavadim uvimshuchrarim: 
Al yaale al datecha sheshshimshon hammoshia et yisrael o shelomo melech yisrael shennikra yedid Adonai nasu nashim nachriyyot begeutan. ella sod haddavar kach hu. shehammitzva hannechona kesheyyavo hagger o haggiyyoret lehitgayyer bodkin acharav shemma biglal mamon sheyyittol o bishvil serara sheyyizke lah o mippene happachad ba lehikkanes laddat. veim ish hu bodkin acharav shemma enav natan beishsha yehudit. veim ishsha hi bodkin shemma eneha natna bevachur mibbachure yisrael. im lo nimtza lahem illa modiin otan koved ol hattora vetorach sheyyesh baasiyyatah al amme haaratzot kede sheyyifroshu. im kibbelu velo pershu verau otan shechazru meahava mekabbelim otan shenneemar <small>(Rut 1 18)</small> "vattere ki mitammetzet hi lalechet ittah vattechdal ledabber eleha": 
Lefichach lo kibbelu bet din gerim kol yeme david ushelomo. bime david shemma min happachad chazru. uvime shelomo shemma bishvil hammalchut vehattova vehaggedulla shehayu bah yisrael chazru. shekkol hachozer min haakkum bishvil davar mehavele haolam eno miggere hatztzedek. veaf al pi chen hayu gerim harebe mitgayyerim bime david ushelomo bifne hedyotot. vehayu bet din haggadol choshshin lahem lo dochin otan achar shettavlu mikkol makom velo mekarvin otan ad shetterae acharitam: 
Ulefi sheggiyyer shelomo nashim unesaan. vechen shimshon giyyer venasa. vehaddavar yadua shello chazru ellu ella bishvil davar velo al pi bet din giyyerum chashavan hakkatuv keillu hen akkum uveissuran omdin. veod shehochiach sofan al techillatan shehen ovdot kochavim umazzalot shellahen uvanu lahen bamot veheela alav hakkatuv keillu hu benaan shenneemar <small>(Melachim 1 11 7)</small> "az yivne shelomo bama": 
Ger shello badku acharav o shello hodiuhu hammitzvot veanshan umal vetaval bifne shelosha hedyotot hare ze ger. afillu noda shebbishvil davar hu mitgayyer hoil umal vetaval yatza mikkelal haakkum vechoshshin lo ad sheyyitbaer tzidkuto. vaafillu chazar veavad avoda zara hare hu keyisrael mumar shekkiddushav kiddushin. umitzva lehachazir avedato meachar shettaval naasa keyisrael. ulefichach kiyyemu shimshon ushelomo neshotehen veaf al pi shennigla sodan: 
Umippene ze amru chachamim kashim lahem gerim leyisrael kenega tzaraat sherubban chozrin bishvil davar umatin et yisrael. vekashe haddavar lifrosh mehem achar shennitgayyeru. tze ulemad ma era bammidbar bemaase haegel uvekivrot hattaava vechen rov hannisyonot haasafsuf hayu bahen techilla:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 14: Ketzad mekabbelin gere hatztzedek. kesheyyavo echad lihitgayyer min haakkum veyivdeku acharav velo yimtzeu illa. omrim lo ma raita shebbata lehitgayyer. i atta yodea sheyyisrael bazzeman hazze devuyim udechufim umesuchafin umetorafin veyissurin bain alehen. im amar ani yodea veeni keday mekabbelin oto miyyad:

Umodiin oto ikkere haddat shehu yichud hashshem veissur akkum. umaarichin baddavar hazze. umodiin oto miktzat mitzvot kallot umiktzat mitzvot chamurot. veen maarichin bedavar ze. umodiin oto avon leket shichcha ufea umaaser sheni. umodiin oto anshan shel mitzvot. ketzad. omrim lo heve yodea shead shello bata ledat zo im achalta chelev i atta anush karet. im chillalta shabbat i atta anush sekila. veachshav achar shettitgayyer im achalta chelev atta anush karet. im chillalta shabbat atta anush sekila. veen marbin alav. veen medakdekin alav. shemma yigrom letardo ulehattoto midderech tova lederech raa. shebbattechilla en moshchin et haadam ella bedivre ratzon verakkim. vechen hu omer <small>(Hoshea 11 4)</small> "bechavle adam emshechem" veachar kach <small>(Hoshea 11 4)</small> "baavotot ahava":

Ucheshem shemmodiin oto anshan shel mitzvot kach modiin oto secharan shel mitzvot. umodiin oto shebbaasiyyat mitzvot ellu yizke lechayye haolam habba. vesheen shum tzaddik gamur ella baal hachachma sheose mitzvot ellu veyodan:

Veomrim lo heve yodea shehaolam habba eno tzafun ella latztzaddikim vehem yisrael. veze shettire yisrael betzaar baolam hazze tova hi tzefuna lahem sheenan yecholin lekabbel rov tova baolam hazze kaummot. shemma yarum libbam veyitu veyafsidu sechar haolam habba kainyan shenneemar <small>(Devarim 32 15)</small> "vayyishman yeshurun vayyivat":

Veen hakkadosh baruch hu mevi alehen rov puranut kede shello yovdu ella kol haakkum kalin vehen omdin. umaarichin baddavar hazze kede lechabbevan. im chazar bo velo ratza lekabbel holech ledarko. veim kibbel en mashhin oto ella malin oto miyyad. veim haya mahul mattifin mimmennu dam berit umashhim oto ad sheyyitrappe refua shelema. veachar kach matbilin oto:

Ushelosha omdin al gabbav umodiin oto miktzat mitzvot kallot umiktzat mitzvot chamurot paam sheniyya vehu omed bammayim. veim hayta ishsha nashim moshivot otah bammayim ad tzavvarah vehaddayyanin mibbachutz umodiin otah miktzat mitzvot kallot vachamurot. vehi yoshevet bammayim veachar kach tovelet bifnehem vehen machzirin penehen veyotzin kede shello yiru otah keshettaale min hammayim:

E ze hu ger toshav ze akkum shekkibbel alav shello yaavod avoda zara im shear hammitzvot shennitztauu bene noach velo mal velo taval hare ze mekabbelin oto vehu mechaside ummot haolam. velamma nikra shemo toshav lefi shemmuttar lanu lehoshivo benenu beeretz yisrael kemo shebbearnu behilchot akkum:
Veen mekabbelin ger toshav ella bizman shehayyovel noheg. aval bazzeman hazze afillu kibbel alav kol hattora kullah chutz middikduk echad en mekabbelin oto:

Haeved hannilkach min haakkum en omrin lo ma raita shebbata. ella omrim lo retzoncha shettikkanes lichlal avde yisrael vetihye min hakkesherim o lo. im ratza modiin lo ikkere haddat umiktzat mitzvot kallot vachamurot veanshan usecharan kemo shemmodiin et hagger umatbilin oto keger. umodiin oto keshehu bammayim. veim lo ratza lekabbel megalgelin alav kol shenem asar chodesh umochro leakkum. veasur lekayyemo yoter al ken. veim hitna alav mittechilla shello yamul velo yitbol ella yihye ger toshav muttar lekayyemo baavodato keshehu ger toshav. veen mekayyemin eved kaze ella bizman hayyovel:
Haakkum en asurim alehem mishshum erva ella immo veeshet aviv vaachoto meimmo veeshet ish vezachar uvehema kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot melachim umilchamotehen. aval shear arayot muttarin lahen:

Akkum shennitgayyer veeved shennishtachrer hare hu kekatan shennolad. vechol sheer basar shehayu lo keshehu akkum o keshehu eved enan sheer basar. veim nitgayyer hu vehem eno chayyav al achat mehem mishshum erva kelal:

Din tora shemmuttar leakkum sheyyissa immo o achoto meimmo shennitgayyeru. aval chachamim asru davar ze kede shello yomru banu mikkedushsha chamura likdushsha kalla. sheemesh hayta lo zo asura vehayyom mutteret. vechen ger shebba al immo o achoto vehi begeutah hare ze keva al hannachrit:

Ketzad din haggerim baarayot shel sheer basar. im haya nasuy keshehu akkum leimmo o laachoto venitgayyeru mafrishin otan kemo shebbearnu. veim haya nasuy lishar arayot venitgayyer hu veishto en mafrishin otan. ger asur bisher haem achar shennitgayyer middivre sofrim. umuttar bisher haav af al pi sheyyodea bevadday shezze sheero meaviv. kegon teomim sheddavar barur sheaviv shel ze hu aviv shel ze af al pi chen lo gazru al sheer aviv. lefichach nose hagger eshet achiv meaviv veeshet achi aviv veeshet aviv veeshet beno af al pi shennisset leachiv o leaviv o laachi aviv o livno achar shennitgayyeru. vechen achot immo meaviha vaachoto meaviv. uvitto shennitgayyera mutteret lo. aval eno nose lo achoto meimmo velo achot immo meimmah velo eshet achiv meimmo shennesaah achiv meimmo achar shennitgayyer. aval im nesaah achiv keshehu akkum hare zo mutteret lo:
Shene achim teomim shehayta horatan shello bikdushsha veledatan bikdushsha chayyavin mishshum eshet ach:

Hannose giyyoret uvittah haggiyyoret o shete achayot min haem yoshev im achat mehen umegaresh hashsheniyya. nasa giyyoret umeta hare ze muttar lissa immah o bittah shello gazru ella bechayyehen. umuttar leadam lissa shete achayot giyyorot min haav shello gazru bisher haav kemo shebbearnu:
Hashsheniyyot kullan lo gazru alehen begerim. lefichach muttar hagger lissa em immo. venose adam giyyoret veem immah o bat bat bittah. vechen bishar hashsheniyyot:

Haeved muttar lissa immo keshehu eved veen tzarich lomar bitto vaachoto vechayyotze bahen shekkevar yatza mikkelal akkum. veen haarayot haasurot al haakkum asurot alav velo ba lichlal yisrael kede sheyyeasru alav arayot haasurot al haggerim:
Veyerae li sheim ba haeved al hazzachur uvehema yeharegu. sheissur shete arayot ellu shave bechol haadam:

Avadim shennishtachreru hare hen kegerim. kol sheasur legerim asur lahen vechol hammuttar legerim muttar lahen. noten adam shifchato leavdo o leeved chavero. umoser shifcha achat lishne avadim lechattechilla veenan tzerichin shum davar ella hare hen kivhemot. veshifcha shehi meyuchedet leeved o sheenah meyuchedet achat hi lefi sheen ishut ella leyisrael o leakkum al haakkum aval lo laavadim al haavadim velo laavadim al yisrael:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 15:
E zehu <small>(Devarim 23 3)</small> "mamzer" haamur battora. ze habba meerva min haarayot. chutz min hannidda shehabben mimmenna pagum veeno mamzer. aval habba al shear haarayot ben beones ben beratzon ben bezadon ben bishgaga havvalad mamzer. veechad zecharim veechad nekevot asurin leolam shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 3)</small> "gam dor asiri" kelomar leolam: 
Echad mamzer shennasa yisreelit o yisreeli shennasa mamzeret kevan shebbaalu achar hakkiddushin lokin. kiddesh velo baal eno loke. baal velo kiddesh enan lokin mishshum mamzerut sheen lecha bechol chayyave lavin mi shelloke al beila belo kiddushin ella kohen gadol bealmana kemo sheyyitbaer. hammachazir gerushato mishshennisset havvalad kasher shehare enah erva: 
Akkum veeved habba al bat yisrael havvalad kasher ben penuya ben beeshet ish ben beones ben beratzon. akkum veeved habbaim al hammamzeret havvalad mamzer. umamzer habba al haakkum havvalad akkum. nitgayyer hare hu kasher kishar gerim. veim ba al hashshifcha havvalad eved. shichrero havvalad kasher kishar avadim meshuchrarin umuttar bevat yisrael: 
Ze hakkelal ben habba min haeved o min haakkum o min hashshifcha o min bat akkum hare hu keimmo veen mashgichin al haav. lefi davar ze hittiru lemamzer lissa shifcha kede letaher et banav shehare hu meshachrer otam venimtzeu bene chorin. velo gazru al hashshifcha lemamzer mippene takkanat habbanim: 
Mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin habba al eshet ish oto habben en lo takkana mippene shetztzad mamzerut vetzad kashrut meoravin bo. lefichach asur beshifcha venimtzeu banav kemoto leolam: 
Akkum habba al hashshifcha shettavla hare ze eved veeved shettaval shebba al akkum havvalad akkum hallech achar haem aval akkum habba al shifcha akkum o eved akkum shebba al akkum bat chorin hallech achar hazzachar: 
Mamzer muttar lissa giyyoret. vechen hammamzeret mutteret leger. vehabbanim mishshenehem mamzerim shehavvalad holech achar happagum shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 3)</small> "bikhal Adonai" ukehal gerim eno karuy <small>(Devarim 23 3)</small> "kehal Adonai": 
Giyyoret shennisset leger veholidu ben af al pi shehorato veledato bikdushsha hare ze muttar bemamzeret. vechen ben ben beno ad sheyyishtakka shem geruto mimmennu velo yivvada shehu ger veachar kach yeaser bemamzeret. veechad haggerim veechad haavadim meshuchrarin din echad lechullan: 
Ger shennasa bat yisrael o yisrael shennasa giyyoret havvalad yisrael lechol davar veasur bemamzeret: 
Shelosha mamzerim hem. mamzer vadday umamzer safek umamzer middivre sofrim. e zehu mamzer vadday ze shebba min haerva havvaddait kemo shebbearnu. umamzer safek ze shebba missefek erva kegon habba al haishsha shennitkaddesha sefek kiddushin o nitgarsha sefek gerushin vechayyotze bahen. middivre sofrim. kegon haishsha sheshshama shemmet balah venisset vahare balah kayyam uva balah harishon aleha vehi tachat hashsheni hare habben mamzer middivre sofrim: 
Penuya shennitabbera mizzenut amru lah mahu haubbar hazze o hayyalud hazze im amra ben kasher hu uleyisrael nivalti hare zo neemenet vehabben kasher. veaf al pi sherov hair shezzinneta bah pesulim: 
Veim lo nivdeka immo ad shemmeta o shehayta chereshet o illemet o shota o sheamra lifloni hammamzer nivalti o lifloni hannatin afillu oto peloni mode shehu mimmennu hare ze hayyalud sefek mamzer. keshem shezzinneta im ze shehoda lah kach zinneta im acher. veze hu hannikra shetuki shemmakkir et immo veeno makkir et aviv vadday: 
Vechen habben hannimtza bashshuk vehu hannikra asufi hare hu sefek mamzer sheen anu yodim ma hu: 
Penuya shezzinneta veamra ben ze ben peloni hu. im oto peloni kasher hare habben kasher veenah neemenet lihyot ze beno shel peloni. veyerae li shechoshshin lidvareha veyihye habben asur bikrovot oto peloni missafek. veim oto peloni mamzer enah neemenet lihyot habben mamzer vadday al piha kemo shebbearnu ella yihye sefek mamzer: 
Aval haav shehuchzak shezze beno veamar beni ze mamzer hu neeman. veim yesh labben banim eno neeman. shello heemina oto tora ella al beno shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 17)</small> "ki et habbechor ben hassenua yakkir" yakkirennu laacherim: 
Ucheshem shenneeman lomar beni ze bechor kach neeman lomar beni ze mamzer o ben gerusha o ben chalutza. vechen im hayta ishto meubberet neeman lomar ubbar ze eno beni umamzer hu veyihye mamzer vadday. vehaomer al atzmo shehu mamzer neeman leesor atzmo bevat yisrael. veasur bemamzeret ad sheyyivvada vadday shehu mamzer. uveno kamohu. veim yesh lo bene banim eno neeman lifsol bene banav velo yifsol ella atzmo: 
Arusa shennitabbera vehi bevet aviha hare havvalad bechezkat mamzer veasur bevat yisrael veasur bemamzeret. veim nivdeka immo veamra mearusi nitabbarti neemenet vehavvalad kasher. veim hichchishah haarus veamar meolam lo bati aleha hare havvalad mamzer sheafillu haya bechezkat beno veamar beni ze mamzer neeman. vehaishsha enah bechezkat zona ella neemenet lomar laarus nivalti veenah zona. veim nisset lechohen lo tetze uveladah mimmennu kasher: 
Hayu haam merannenim achareha vehi arusa im arusah veim anashim acherim af al pi shebba aleha arusah bevet chamiv hare ze sefek mamzer. keshem shehifkira atzmah laarusah hifkira laacherim. veim nivdeka veamra ubbar ze mearusi hare ze kasher kemo shebbearnu: 
Eshet ish shehayta meubberet veamra ubbar ze eno mibbaali enah neemenet lefaslo. vahare habben bechezkat kashrut. shello heemina tora ella haav. amar haav eno beni o shehaya balah bimdinat hayyam hare ze bechezkat mamzer. veim amra meakkum veeved nitabbarti hare havvalad kasher. sheen habbaal yachol lehachechishah bidvareha. veen haubbar mishtahe bime immo yeter al shenem asar chodesh: 
Eshet ish sheyyatza aleha kol shehayta zona tachat balah vehakkol merannenin achareha en choshshin levaneha shemma mamzerim hem sherov beilot etzel habbaal. umuttar lissa bittah lechattechilla. aval hi atzmah choshshin lah mishshum zona. veim hayta perutza yoter midday af levaneha choshshin: 
Din tora shessefek mamzer muttar lavo bakkahal shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 3)</small> "lo yavo mamzer bikhal Adonai" mamzer vadday asur lavo bakkahal velo safek. aval chachamim asu maala beyuchasin veasru gam hassefekot lavo bakkahal. lefichach mamzer vadday muttar lissa mamzeret vaddait aval mamzer safek o shetuki o asufi asur lissa bat yisrael: 
Veasur lissa mamzeret vaafillu mamzeret missafek asura lo shemma echad mehen eno mamzer vehashsheni mamzer vadday. umamzer shel divrehem muttar lissa mamzeret shel divrehem. vechen shear hassefekot asurin lissa ze mizze: 
Ketzad. shetukim vaasufim usefek mamzerim asurim lavo ze im ze veim nasu lo yekayyemu ella yotziu beget vehavvalad safek kaavotav. veen lisfekot ellu takkana ella sheyyisseu min haggerim vehavvalad holech achar happagum: 
Ketzad. shetuki o asufi shennasa giyyoret o meshuchreret o ger umeshuchrar shennasa shetukit o asufit. havvalad shetuki o asufi: 
Haasufi shennimtza beir sheyyesh bah akkum ben shehaya rov akkum o rov yisrael hare ze sefek akkum leinyan yuchasin. kiddesh ishsha tzericha get missafek. mi sheharago lo haya neherag alav: 
Hitbiluhu bet din leshem gerut o shettaval mishshehigdil hare hu kishar asufim hannimtzaim beare yisrael. haya rov hair akkum muttar lehaachilo nevelot. haya rubban yisrael machzirin lo avedato keyisrael. mechetza al mechetza mitzva lehachayoto keyisrael. umefakkechin alav et haggal beshabbat vahare hu leinyan nezakin kechol sefek mamon hammotzi mechavero alav haraya: 
Yerae li shekkol medina sheyyesh bah shifcha o akkum haruya leled hoil vehaasufi hannimtza sham sefek akkum o sefek eved kesheyyissa haggiyyoret kemo shebbearnu hare zo sefek eshet ish vehabba aleha patur sheen horgin al safek. vechen yerae li shehashshetuki shennasa ishsha sheefshar shehi erva alav vahare hi sefek eshet ish sheen kiddushin tofsin baarayot: 
Vee zo hi haishsha sheefshar shettihye erva alav. kol ishsha shehaya aviha o achiha kayyam keshennitabbera bo immo. vechol ishsha shennitgarsha o nitalmena shemma eshet aviv hi o eshet achi aviv: 
Uminnayin ani omer sheen hashshetuki vehaasufi asur bechol ishsha sheefshar shettihye erva alav. shehare hakkasher shennivdeka immo eno asur bechol ishsha sheefshar shettihye erva alav. vahare neemar battora <small>(Vayikra 19 29)</small> "al techallel et bittecha lehazenotah". veamru chachamim sheim yaase ze nimtza av nose bitto veach nose achoto. veillu haya haddin shekkol mi sheeno yodea aviv bevadday asur bechol ishsha sheefshar shettihye erva alav. lo hayinu baim lammidda hazzot leolam velo tihye haaretz melea zimma. ha lamadta sheen osrin arayot umachazikin otan bisher basar besafek ad sheyyivvada bevadday shezzo erva alav. sheim atta omer ken kol hayetomim shebbaolam shello hikkiru avotehem hayu asurin lehinnase bechol makom shemma yifgeu beerva: 
Havvalad shehaya mushlach badderech uva echad veamar beni hu vaani hishlachtiv neeman. vechen immo neemenet. neesaf min hashshuk uvau aviv veimmo achar ken veamru benenu hu en neemanin hoil veyatza alav shem asufi. uvishne reavon neemanin shemmippene raav hishlichuhu vehen rotzin sheyyazunu oto acherim ulefichach shatku ad shenneesaf: 
Nimtza havvalad mahul o shehuchtal o shehumlach o shehaya hakkochal beenav o hakkemein betzavvaro o shennimtza tachat ilan mesubbach sheen chayya nichneset lo vehaya samuch lair o shennimtza bevet hakkeneset hassamuch lirshut harabbim o betzidde reshut harabbim en kan mishshum asufi. meacher shehen meshammerin oto shello yamut bechezkat kasher hu. aval im nimtza mushlach beemtza hadderech o rachok min hair afillu tachat ilan o bevet hakkeneset o shennimtza taluy bailan makom shechayya maggaat lo hare ze asufi: 
Neemenet chayya lomar ze habben kohen hu o levi o natin o mamzer mippene shello huchzak veen anu yodin yichusan. bamme devarim amurim beshehuchzeka beneemanut velo irer aleha adam. aval im irer aleha afillu echad veamar besheker meida enah neemenet vahare habben bechezkat kasher veen lo yichus: 
Davar barur shehashshetuki asur lissa shetukit. vaasufi asur baasufit mippene shehen sefekot. aval mamzerim vaddaim unetinim muttarim lavo ze baze vehavvalad mamzer. ushetuki vaasufi muttarin bintinim uvishar haggerim vehavvalad safek:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 16:
Petzua dakka ucherut shafcha shennasu bat yisirael uvaalu lokin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 2)</small> "lo yavo fetzua dakka ucherut shafcha bikhal Adonai". umuttarin lissa giyyoret umeshuchreret. vaafillu kohen shehu petzua dakka muttar lissa giyyoret umeshuchreret lefi sheeno bikdushshato. vaafillu netina o echad min hassefekot mutteret lo: 
Hoil ufetzua dakka asur lavo bakkahal lo gazru bo al hannetinim velo al hassefekot. aval petzua dakka ucherut shafcha asur bemamzeret vaddait shehare asura min hattora: 
Ve zehu petzua dakka. kol shenniftzeu habbetzim shello. ucherut shafcha kol shennichrat haggid shello. uvishlosha evarin efshar sheyyippasel hazzachar baggid uvabbetzim uvashshevilin shebbahen titbashshel shichvat zera vehen hannikrain chute betzim. vechevan shenniftza echad mishshelosha evarin ellu o niddach hare ze pasul: 
Ketzad. niftza haggid o niddach o shennichrat haatara o lemala meatara pasul. veim nichrat merosh haatara venishtayyer mimmenna afillu kechut hassaara mukkaf lechol haggid kasher. nichrat haggid lemala meatara kekulmos o kemarzev kasher: 
Nikkav lematta meatara kasher. nikkeva haatara atzmah im kesheyyire keri tetze shichvat zera min hannekev pasul. nistam hannekev chazar lehechshero. nikkav lematta meatara shekkenegdo lemala betoch haatara pasul shehaatara kullah meakkevet: 
Nistam shevil shichvat zera vechazar lirot shichvat zera mishshevil shemmashtin bo hare ze pasul: 
Nichretu habbetzim o achat mehen o shenniftzea achat mehen o shenniddocha achat mehen o shechasra o shennikkeva hare ze pasul. nichretu chute betzim o achat o shenniddach o niftza hare ze pasul: 
Nikkav chut michute habbetzim lishvil me raglayim vahare hu mattil mayim mishshene mekomot mishshevil hammayim umishshevil shichvat zera hare ze kasher: 
Kol pasul sheamarnu beinyan ze keshello hayu bide shamayim kegon shekkerato adam o kelev o hikkahu kotz vechayyotze bidvarim ellu. aval im nolad kerut shafcha o petzua dakka o shennolad belo betzim o shechala mechamat gufo uvatlu mimmennu evarim ellu o shennolad bahem shechin vehemessa otan o keratan hare ze kasher lavo bakkahal shekkol ellu bide shamayim: 
Asur lehafesid evre zera ben beadam ben bivhema chayya veof. echad temeim veechad tehorim. ben beeretz yisrael ben bechutza laaretz. af al pi shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 24)</small> "uveartzechem lo taasu" mippi hashshemua lamdu sheddavar ze noheg bechol makom. veinyan hakkatuv lo yease zot beyisrael ben begufan ben beguf acherim. vechol hamesares loke min hattora bechol makom. vaafillu mesares achar mesares loke: 
Ketzad. hare shebba echad vecharat et haggid uva acher vecharat et habbetzim o nittekan uva acher vecharat chute betzim. o shebba echad umaach et haggid uva acher venitteko uva acher ucherato kullan lokin. veaf al pi shello seres haacharon ella mesoras. ben baadam ben bivhema chayya vaof. vehamesares et hannekeva ben beadam ben bishar minim patur: 
Hammashke ikkarin leadam o lishar minim kede lesarso hare ze asur veen lokin alav. veishsha mutteret lishtot ikkarin kede lesarsah ad shello teled. hare shekkafa et haadam veshissa bo kelev o shear chayyot ad sheasauhu kerut shafcha o shehoshivo bammayim o bashsheleg ad shebbittel mimmennu evre tashmish eno loke ad sheyyesares beyado. verauy lehakkoto makkat mardut: 
Asur lomar leakkum lesares behema shellanu. veim lekachah hu meatzmo vesersah muttar. veim heerim yisrael bedavar ze konsin oto umochrah leyisrael acher. vaafillu livno haggadol muttar lemachrah. aval livno hakkatan eno mochrah lo velo notna lo:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 17:
Shalosh nashim neesru al kol hakkohanim. gerusha zona vachlola. vial kohen gadol arba. ellu hashshalosh vehaalmana. echad kohen gadol mashuach beshemen hammishcha o hamerubbe begadim. veechad kohen haoved veechad kohen gadol shemminnuhu veavar. vechen kohen meshuach milchama. kullan metzuvvin al habbetula vaasurin bealmana: 
Kol kohen shennasa achat mehashshalosh nashim ellu ben gadol ben hedyot uvaal loke. veim ba aleha derech zenut eno loke mishshum zona o gerusha o chalala shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 7)</small> "lo yikkachu" ad sheyyikkach veyivol: 
Aval kohen gadol shebba al almana loke achat af al pi shello kiddesh shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 15)</small> "lo yechallel" kevan shebbealah chillelah ufesalah lichhunna. aval zona vachalala ugerusha hare hen mechullalot veomdot kodem beilato. ulefichach loke kohen gadol levaddo al beilat almana levaddah af al pi sheen sham kiddushin shehare chillelah vehu muzhar shello yechallel kesherim lo ishsha velo zaro: 
Kiddesh kohen gadol almana uvealah loke shetayim. achat mishshum <small>(Vayikra 21 14)</small> "almana lo yikkach". veachat mishshum <small>(Vayikra 21 15)</small> "lo yechallel". uven kohen gadol uven kohen hedyot shennasa ishsha min haarba velo baal eno loke: 
Vechol makom shehu loke hi loka. vechol makom shehu eno loke hi enah loka. sheen hefresh ben ish leishsha loonashin zulati beshifcha charufa bilvad kemo shebbearnu: 
Kol kohen habba al hakkutit ben gadol ben hedyot loke mishshum zona. shehare enah bat kiddushin vehu asur bivilat zona ben yisreelit ben kutit: 
Hachalutza asura lechohen middivre sofrim mippene shehi kigrusha umakkin oto makkat mardut middivrehem. kohen shennasa sefek chalutza en motziin otah mittachtav vehi keshera uveladah kasher. mippene shello gazru al sefek chalutza ella al chalutza vaddait. vechen mi shehayta sefek gerusha o sefek almana o sefek zona usefek chalala makkin oto makkat mardut umotzi beget: 
Kelal gadol hu bechol issurim shebbattora sheen issur chal al issur ella im ken hayu shene issurin bain keachat. o shehaya haissur haechad mosif devarim acherim al oto haissur. o im haya kolel devarim acherim im issur ze: 
Lefichach ishsha shehayta almana venaaset gerusha venaaset chalala venaaset zona uva aleha kohen gadol achar kach loke arba malkiyyot al bia achat. lefi shehaalmana asura lechohen gadol umutteret lehedyot. 
Chazra lihyot gerusha nosaf bah issur veneeseret lechohen hedyot. lefichach nosaf bah issur acher al issur haalmana vaadayin hi mutteret leechol bitruma. naaset chalala nosaf bah issur shehare neeseret bitruma vaadayin hi mutteret leyisrael. naaset zona hoil veyesh shem zenut sheosrah al yisrael im zinneta ishto beratzon nosaf bah issur acher. vehu haddin lechohen hedyot shebba al haggerusha shennaaset chalala veachar kach zona shehu loke shalosh al bia achat. aval im nishtanna seder ze eno loke ella achat: 
Mi shennitalmena meanashim harebe o nitgarsha meanashim harebe en lokin aleha ella achat al kol bia. almana ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin asura: 
Kohen gadol shemmet achiv af al pi shehu min haerusin hare ze lo yeyabbem ella choletz. nafla lo yevama vehu kohen hedyot venitmanna lihyot kohen gadol af al pi sheasa bah maamar keshehu kohen hedyot hare ze lo yeyabbem achar shennitmanna. aval im eres et haalmana venitmanna lihyot kohen gadol hare ze yichnos achar shennitmanna. hayta mekuddeshet sefek kiddushin umet arusah hare zo sefek almana: 
Mitzvat ase al kohen gadol sheyyissa naara betula. umishshettivgor teaser alav shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 13)</small> "vehu ishsha vivtuleha yikkach". ishsha lo ketanna. bivtuleha velo bogeret. ha ketzad. yatzat mikkelal katnut velichlal bagrut lo baa zo naara. veeno nose shete nashim leolam keachat shenneemar ishsha achat velo shetayim: 
Kohen gadol lo yissa mukkat etz af al pi shello nivala. [nivala shello kedarkah hare zo kenivala kedarkah. nivala livhema hare zo mutteret]: 
Kohen gadol shennasa beula eno loke aval motzi beget. nasa bogeret o mukkat etz hare ze yekayyem. eres beula venitmanna kohen gadol hare ze yichnos achar shennitmanna: 
Anas naara betula o pitta otah afillu anasah o pitta otah keshehu kohen hedyot venitmanna kohen gadol kodem sheyyichnos hare ze lo yichnos. veim kanas motzi: 
Eres et hakketanna uvagra tachtav kodem nissuin hare ze lo yichnos mippene shennishtanna gufah. veim kanas lo yotzi: 
Achat gerusha min haerusin o min hannissuin. aval hamemaenet afillu gershah beget vehechezirah umeana bo hare zo mutteret lechohen kemo shebbearnu behilchot gerushin. vechol mi sheenah reuya lachalitza im nechletza lo nifsela lichhunna: 
Yatza aleha kol ish peloni kohen katav get leishto o natan get leishto vahare hi yoshevet tachtav umeshammashto. en motziin otah mittachat balah. veim nisset lechohen acher tetze min hashsheni: 
Yatza shemah bair shennitkaddesha venitgarsha min hakkiddushin choshshin lah kemo shebbearnu behilchot gerushin. aval im yatza aleha kol shehi chalutza en choshshin lah: 
Yatza kol al habbetula shehi beula en choshshin lah vetinnase lechohen gadol. yatza aleha kol shehi shifcha en choshshin lah vetinnase afillu lechohen. yatza lah shem mezanna bair en choshshin lah. vaafillu hotziah balah mishshum sheavra al dat yehudit o beede davar mechoar umet kodem sheyyitten lah get hare zo mutteret lechohen. sheen osrin ishsha meellu ella beedut berura o bihodaat piha:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 18:
Mippi hashshemua lamadnu sheah <small>(Vayikra 21 7 14)</small> "zona" haamura battora hi kol sheenah bat yisrael. o bat yisrael shennivala leadam shehi asura lehinnase lo issur hashshave lakkol. o shennivala lechalal af al pi shehi mutteret lehinnase lo. lefichach hannirbaat livhema af al pi shehi biskila lo naaset zona velo nifsela lichhunna shehare lo nivala leadam. vehabba al hannidda af al pi shehi becharet lo naaset zona velo nifsela lichhunna shehare enah asura lehinnase lo: 
Vechen habba al happenuya afillu hayta kedesha shehifkira atzmah lakkol af al pi shehi bemalkot lo naaset zona velo nifsela min hakkehunna shehare enah asura lehinnase lo. aval hannivelet leechad meissure lavin hashshavin bakkol veen meyuchadin bechohanim. o meissure ase. veen tzarich lomar lemi shehi asura lo mishshum erva o leakkum veeved. hoil vehi asura lehinnase lo hare zo zona: 
Vechen haggiyyoret vehameshuchreret afillu nitgayyera venishtachrera pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim hoil veenah bat yisrael hare zo zona vaasura lechohen. mikkan amru akkum o natin o mamzer o ger ammoni umoavi o mitzri veedomi rishon vesheni o petzua dakka ucherut shafcha o chalal shebbau al hayyehudit asu otah zona venifsela lichhunna veim hayta kohenet pesaluha min hatteruma. vechen yevama shebba aleha zar asaah zona. vehaaylonit mutteret lechohen veenah zona: 
Habba al achat mehashsheniyyot vechayyotze bahen kegon habba al kerovat chalutzato o al chalutzato lo asa otah zona shehare enah asura lehinnase lo min hattora kemo shebbearnu behilchot yibbum: 
Ha lamadta sheen heyotah zona tole bivila shel issur. shehare habba al hannidda veal hakkedesha vehannirbaat labbehema nivala beila shel issur velo naaset zona. umi shennisset lechalal nivala beila shel hetter kemo sheyyitbaer venaaset zona veen haddavar taluy ella bifgima umippi hashshemua lamdu sheenah peguma ella meadam haasur lah o mechalal kemo sheamarnu: 
Kol hannivelet leadam sheose otah zona ben beones ben beratzon ben bezadon ben bishgaga [ben kedarkah ben shello kedarkah] mishsheheera bah nifsela mishshum zona. uvilvad shettihye bat shalosh shanim veyom echad veyihye habboel ben tesha shanim veyom echad vamala. lefichach eshet ish shennivala leacher ben beones ben beratzon nifsela lichhunna: 
Eshet kohen shenneensa balah loke aleha mishshum tuma shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 4)</small> "lo yuchal balah harishon asher shillechah lashuv lekachtah lihyot lo leishsha achare asher hutammaa". hakkol bichlal sheim nivalu asurin al baalehen. peret lecha hakkatuv beeshet yisrael shenneensa shehi mutteret levalah shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 13)</small> "vehi lo nitpasa" aval eshet kohen beissurah omedet shehare hi zona: 
Eshet yisrael shenneensa af al pi shehi mutteret levalah asura lichhunna. eshet kohen sheamra levalah neenasti o shagagti uva alay echad o shebba ed echad veheid lo aleha shezzinneta ben beones ben beratzon hare zo enah asura alav. shemma eneha natna beacher. veim hi neemenet lo o haed neeman lo vesamach dato ledivrehem hare ze yotzi kede latzet yede safek: 
Eshet kohen sheamra levalah neenasti af al pi shehi mutteret levalah kemo shebbearnu hare hi asura lechol kohen shebbaolam achar sheyyamut balah. shehare hodet shehi zona veasra atzmah venaaset kachaticha haasura: 
Kohen shekkiddesh gedola o ketanna veachar zeman ba aleha vetaan shemmetzaah derusat ish neesra alav missafek shemma kodem kiddushin nivala o achar kiddushin. aval yisrael shettaan taana zo lo neesra alav sheyyesh kan shene sefekot shemma kodem kiddushin veshemma achar kiddushin. vaafillu nomar leachar kiddushin shemma beones shemma beratzon. shehaanusa mutteret leyisrael kemo shebbearnu: 
Lefichach im kiddeshah aviha leyisrael vehi pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veyom echad vetaan shemmetzaah derusat ish neesra alav missafek sheen kan ella safek echad shemma beones shemma beratzon vesafek issur shel tora lechumra: 
Kol ishsha shekkinne lah balah venistera velo shatat me sota asura lechohen mippene shehi sefek zona. ben shello ratzat hi lishtot. ben shello ratza lehashekotah. ben shehayta sham edut shemmonah millishtot. ben shekkinneu lah bet din. ben shehayta min hannashim sheen reuyot lishtot. hoil velo shatat mikkol makom hare zo asura lichhunna missafek: 
Penuya sherauha shennivala leechad vehalach lo veamru lah mi hu ze shebba alayich veamra adam kasher hare zo neemenet. velo od ella afillu rauha meubberet veamru lah mimmi nitabbart veamra meadam kasher hare zo neemenet vetihye mutteret lechohen: 
Bamme devarim amurim besheyyihye hammakom shennivala bo parashat derachim o bikranot shebbassadot shehakkol ovrin sham. vehayu rov haovrim sham kesherim verov hair shepparshu ellu haovrin mimmenna kesherim. shehachachamim asu maala beyuchasin vehitzrichu shene rubbot. aval im hayu rov haovrim poslim otah kegon akkum o mamzerim vechayyotze bahem af al pi sherov hammakom shebbau mimmenna kesherim o shehayu rov anshe hammakom pesulin af al pi sherov haovrin sham kesherim choshshin lah shemma lemi shepposel otah nivala velo tinnase lechohen lechattechilla. veim nisset (lo) tetze: 
Rauha shennivala bair o nitabbera bair afillu lo haya shochen sham ella akkum echad o chalal echad veeved vechayyotze bahen hare zo lo tinnase lechattechilla lechohen. shekkol hakkavua kemechetza al mechetza hu. veim nisset lo tetze hoil vehi omeret lechasher nivalti: 
Hayta illemet o chereshet o sheamra eni yodaat lemi nivalti o shehayta ketanna sheenah makkeret ben kasher lefasul hare zo sefek zona. veim nisset lechohen tetze ella im ken hayu shene harubbin hammetzuyin etzlah kesherim:
