Hashshevuya shennifdet vehi bat shalosh shanim veyom echad o yeter asura lechohen mippene shehi sefek zona shemma nivala leakkum. veim yesh lah ed shello nityached haakkum immah hare zo keshera lichhunna. vaafillu eved o shifcha o karov neeman leedut zo. ushete shevuyot sheheida kol achat mehen lachavertah hare ellu neemanot. hoil veissur kol hassefekot kullan middivre sofrim lefichach hekellu bishvuya: 
Vechen katan shehaya mesiach lefi tummo neeman. maase beechad shennishba hu veimmo uvenah mesiach lefi tummo veamar nishbenu leven haakkum ani veimmi yatzati lishov mayim vedati al immi lilkot etzim vedati al immi. vehissiu otah chachamim lechohen al piv: 
En habbaal neeman lehaid beishto hashshevuya shello nitmea. sheen adam meid leatzmo. vechen shifchatah lo taid lah. aval shifchat balah meida lah. veshifchatah shehayta mesicha lefi tummah neemenet: 
Kohen sheheid lishvuya shehi tehora hare ze lo yissaenna shemma enav natan bah. veim pedaah veheid bah hare ze yissaenna. sheillu lo yada shehi tehora lo natan bah meotav: 
Haishsha sheamra nishbeti utehora ani neemenet shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir afillu haya sham ed echad shemmeid shehi shevuya. aval im yesh sham shene edim shennishbet enah neemenet ad sheyyaid lah echad shehi tehora. hayu sham shene edim shennishbet veed echad meid shennitmet veechad machchish oto umeid lah shehi tehora velo nityached immah akkum ad shennifdet. afillu ze shemmeid shehi tehora ishsha o shifcha hare zo mutteret: 
Mi sheamra nishbeti utehora ani vehittiruha bet din lehinnase veachar kach bau shene edim shennishbet hare zo tinnase lechattechilla velo tetze mehetterah. vaafillu nichnas achareha shabbay vahare hi shevuya lefanenu beyad adoneha hare zo lo tetze mehetterah shehittiruha. umeshammerin otah meatta ad shettippade: 
Bau lah shene edim achar kach shennitmet afillu nisset vaafillu hayu lah banim hare zo tetze. veim ba ed echad eno kelum. amra nishbeti utehora ani veyesh li edim sheani tehora en omrin namtin ad sheyyavou haedim ella mattirin otah miyyad. velo od ella afillu yatza aleha kol sheyyesh aleha ede tuma mattirin otah ad sheyyavou. shebbishvuya hekellu: 
Haav sheamar kiddashti et bitti vegerashtiha vahare hi ketanna neeman. kiddashtiha vegerashtiha keshehayta ketanna vahare hi gedola eno neeman lehachazikah gerusha. nishbet ufeditiha ben shehi gedola ben shehi ketanna eno neeman. shello heemina oto tora ella leasrah mishshum ishut shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 16)</small> "et bitti natatti laish hazze". aval lo lefaslah mishshum zenut: 
Eshet kohen shenneesra alav mishshum shevuya hoil vehaddavar safek hare zo mutteret ladur immo bechatzer echad uvilvad sheyyihyu immo banav uvene beto tamid leshamro: 
Ir shebbaa bematzor venichbesha im hayu haakkum makkifin et hair mikkol ruchoteha kede shello timmalet ishsha achat ad sheyyiru otah vetease birshutan hare kol hannashim shebbetochah pesulot lichhunna kishvuyot shemma nivalu leakkum. ella mi shehayta mibbat shalosh shanim ulematta kemo shebbearnu: 
Veim haya efshar shettimmalet ishsha achat velo yedu bah o shettihye bair machavoa achat afillu enah machzeket ella ishsha achat hare zo matztzelet al hakkol: 
Ketzad matztzelet. shekkol ishsha sheamra tehora ani neemenet. veaf al pi sheen lah ed mittoch sheyyechola lomar nimlatti keshennichbesha hair o bemachavoa hayiti venitztzalti neemenet lomar lo nimlatti velo nechbeti velo nitmeti: 
Bamme devarim amurim bigdud shel otah malchut shehem mityashshevin bair veen yerein lefichach choshshin lahem shemma baalu. aval gedud shel malchut acheret sheppashat veshataf veavar lo neesru hannashim mippene sheen lahem penay livol shehen oskim bashshalal uvorchin lahem. veim shavu nashim venaasu birshutan af al pi sheradfu acharehem yisrael vehitztzilu otan miyyadam hare hen asurot: 
Haishsha shenechbesha beyad akkum al yede mamon mutteret. al yede nefashot asura lichhunna ulefichach im haya balah kohen neesra alav. bamme devarim amurim bizman sheyyad yisrael takkifa al haakkum vehem yerein mehem. aval bizman sheyyad haakkum takkifa afillu al yede mamon kevan shennaaset birshut haakkum neesra ella im ken heid lah echad kishvuya kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 19: E zo hi chalala zo shennolida meissur kehunna. vechen achat min hannashim haasurot lichhunna shennivala lechohen nitchallela. aval hakkohen atzmo sheavar haavera lo nitchallel:

Uven shennivala beones o bishgaga [ben kedarkah ben shello kedarkah] mishsheheera bah nitchallela. vehu sheyyihye kohen ben tesha shanim veyom echad vamala vetihye zo haasura lo bat shalosh shanim veyom echad vamala:

Ketzad. kohen ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al haggerusha o al hazzona. vechohen gadol shebba alehen o al haalmana o shennasa beula uva aleha hare ellu nitchallelu leolam. veim holid mimmenna ben ben ze shechillelah ben kohen achar havvalad chalal. aval kohen shekkiddesh ishsha meissure kehunna venitalmena o nitgarsha min haerusin lo nitchallela. veim nisset af al pi shello nivala nitchallela shekkol nesua bechezkat beula hi af al pi shennimtzet betula:
Kohen gadol shennasa bogeret o mukkat etz lo chillelah. vechen im baal beula belo nissuin lo chillelah:

Kohen habba al erva min haarayot chutz minnidda o al achat mechayyave lavin hashshavin bakkol asa otah zona kemo shebbearnu. chazar uva aleha bia sheniyya ben hu ben kohen acher naaset chalala vezaro mimmenna chalalim. lefichach kohen shebba al zekuka leyavam venitabbera mibbia rishona havvalad kasher lefi sheenah meissure kehunna venaaset zona. chazar uva aleha bia sheniyya venitabbera veyalda hi chalala uveladah chalal lefi shehu meissure kehunna:
Vechen kohen habba al haggiyyoret vehameshuchreret chillelah vezaro mimmenna chalalim. kohen habba al hannidda havvalad kasher veeno chalal sheen issur hannidda meyuchad bechohanim ella shave bakkol:
Kohen shennasa gerusha meubberet ben mimmennu ben meacher veyalda keshehi chalala havvalad kasher shehare lo ba mittippat avera:

Kevar bearnu shehachalutza asura lechohen middivrehem. lefichach kohen shebba al hachalutza hare zo chalala vezarah mikkohen chalalim vehakkol middivrehen. aval kohen shebba al achat mehashsheniyyot hi keshera vezaro mimmenna kesherim. sheissur hashsheniyyot issur hashshave bakkol hu veeno meyuchad bechohanim:
Kohen shebba al sefek zona kegon sefek giyyoret o meshuchreret. o shebba al sefek gerusha. vechen kohen gadol shebba al sefek almana hare zo sefek chalala uveladah sefek chalal:

Nimtzeu hachalalim shelosha. chalal min hattora. vechalal middivrehem. usefek chalal. vechol sefek chalal notnin alav chumre kohanim vechumre yisrael. eno ochel bitruma velo mittamme lammetim venose ishsha haruya lechohen. veim achal o nitma o nasa gerusha makkin oto makkat mardut. vehu haddin bechalal shel divrehem. aval chalal shel tora havvadday hare hu kezar venose gerusha umittamme lammetim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 1)</small> "emor el hakkohanim bene aharon". af al pi shehem bene aharon ad sheyyihyu bechihunam:

Kohen zachar shehu asur lissa zona vachalala asur begiyyoret umeshuchreret shehi kezona kemo shebbearnu. aval hakkohenet mutteret lehinnase lechalal uleger velimshuchrar shello huzharu kesherot lehinnase lifsulin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 1)</small> "bene aharon" velo benot aharon. nimtza hagger muttar lissa mamzeret velissa kohenet:

Gerim umeshuchrarim shennasu ellu meellu veholidu bat afillu leachar kamma dorot hoil velo nitarev bahen zera yisrael hare otah habbat asura lechohen. veim nisset lo tetze hoil vehoratah veledatah bikdushsha. aval ger o meshuchrar shennasa bat yisrael o yisrael shennasa giyyoret o meshuchreret bitto keshera lichhunna lechattechilla:
Ger ammoni shennasa bat yisrael vechen mitzri sheni shennasa bat yisrael af al pi shebbiatam baavera vahare neshotehen zonot kemo shebbearnu benotehem kesherot lichhunna lechattechilla:

Chalal shennasa keshera zaro mimmenna chalalim. vechen ben ben beno vaafillu achar elef dor. shebben hechalal hazzachar hu chalal leolam. veim hayta bat asura hi lichhunna shehare hi chalala. aval yisrael shennasa chalala havvalad kasher. lefichach im hayta bat hare zo tinnase lichhunna lechattechilla:

Kohanim uleviyyim veyisreelim muttarin lavo ze baze. vehavvalad holech achar hazzachar. (leviyyim veyisreelim vachalalim muttarim lavo ze baze vehavvalad holech achar hazzachar). shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 1 18)</small> "vayyityaldu al mishpechotam levet avotam". bet aviv hi mishpachto veen bet immo mishpachto:

Leviyyim veyisreelim vachalalim gerim vaavadim meshuchrarim muttarim lavo ze baze. vehagger vehameshuchrar shennasa leviyya o yisreelit o chalala hare habben yisreeli. veyisreeli o levi o chalal shennasu giyyoret o meshuchreret havvalad holech achar hazzachar:

Kol mishpachot bechezkat kesherot umuttar lissa mehen lechattechilla. veaf al pi chen im raita shete mishpachot shemmitgarot zo bazo tamid o raita mishpacha shehi baalat matztza umeriva tamid. o raita ish shehu marbe meriva im hakkol veaz panim beyoter. choshshin lahen verauy lehitrachek mehen sheellu simane paslut hem. vechen happosel et acherim tamid. kegon shennoten shemetz bemishpachot o bichidim veomer alehen shehen mamzerim. choshshin lo shemma mamzer hu. veim amar lahen shehem avadim choshshin lo shemma eved hu. shekkol happosel bemumo posel. vechen kol mi sheyyesh bo azzut panim o achzariyyut vesone et habberiyyot veeno gomel lahem chesed choshshin lo beyoter shemma givoni hu. shessimane yisrael haumma hakkedosha bayshanin rachamanim vegomle chasadim. uvaggivonim hu omer <small>(Shmuel 2 21 2)</small> "vehaggivonim lo mibbene yisrael hemma" lefi sheheezzu penehem velo nitpayyesu velo richamu al bene shaul velo gamlu leyisrael chesed limchol livne malkam vehem asu immahem chesed vehecheyum battechilla:

Mishpacha shekkara aleha arar vehu sheyyaidu shenayim shennitarev bahen mamzer o chalal o sheyyesh bahen avdut hare ze safek. veim mishpachat kohanim hi lo yissa mimmenna ishsha ad sheyyivdok aleha arba immahot shehen shemone. immah. veem immah. veem avi immah. veem em avi immah. vechen hu bodek al em aviha. veem em aviha. veem avi aviha. veem em avi aviha:
Veim hayta mishpacha zo shekkara aleha arar leviyyim o yisreelim. mosif livdok lahem zug echad. venimtza bodek eser immahot. shehaeruv balviyyim veyisreelim yeter min hakkohanim:

Velamma bodek bannashim bilvad. mippene shehaanashim kol et sheyyarivu ze im ze yecharef et chavero bifsul sheyyesh beyichuso. veillu haya sham pasul haya nishma. aval hannashim en mecharfot beyuchasin:
Velamma yivdok haish kesheyyirtze lissa mimmishpacha zo shehura chezkatah velo tivdok ishsha shettinnase lahen. mippene shello huzharu kesherot lehinnase lifsulin:
Kol shekkorin lo mamzer veshotek. o natin veshotek. o chalal veshotek. o eved veshotek. choshshin lo ulemishpachto veen nosin mehen ella im ken bodkin kemo shebbearnu:

Mishpacha shennitarev bah sefek chalal kol almana meotah mishpacha asura lechohen lechattechilla. veim nisset lo tetze mippene shehen shete sefekot. shemma zo almenat oto chalal shemma enah almenato. veim nomar shehi almenato shemma chalal hu shemma eno chalal. aval im nitarev bah chalal vadday kol ishsha mehen asura lechohen ad sheyyivdok. veim nisset tetze. vehu haddin im nitarev bah sefek mamzer o mamzer vadday. sheeshet mamzer veeshet chalal lichhunna issur echad hu kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 20:
Kol kohanim bazzeman hazze bachazaka hem kohanim veen ochlin ella bekadshe haggevul. vehu shettihye teruma shel divrehem. aval teruma shel tora vechalla shel tora en ochel otah ella kohen meyuchas: 
E zehu kohen meyuchas kol sheheidu lo shene edim shehu kohen ben peloni hakkohen ufeloni ben peloni hakkohen ad ish sheeno tzarich bedika vehu hakkohen sheshshimmesh al gabbe hammizbeach. sheillu lo badku bet din haggadol acharav lo hayu menichin oto laavod. lefichach en bodkin mehammizbeach vamala velo min hassanhedrin vamala. sheen memannin bassanhedrin ella kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim meyuchasin: 
Challa bazzeman hazze vaafillu beeretz yisrael enah shel tora shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 18)</small> "bevoachem el haaretz" biat kullechem velo biat miktzatchem. ucheshealu bime ezra lo alu kullam. vechen teruma bazzeman hazze shel divre sofrim ulefichach ochlim otah hakkohanim shebbizmannenu shehen bachazaka: 
Mi sheheidu alav [shene] edim sherauhu shehaya ochel bitruma shel tora hare ze meyuchas. veen maalin leyuchasin lo minnesiat kappayim velo mikkeria battora rishon velo mechilluk teruma bevet haggeranot velo al pi ed echad: 
Kohen meyuchas sheamar beni ze kohen hu en maalin oto leyuchasin al piv ad sheyyavi edim shehu beno: 
Kohen meyuchas sheyyatza hu veishto sheyyadanu shehi keshera limdina acheret uva hu vehi uvanim keruchin acharehen veamar ishsha sheyyatzat immi hi zo veellu baneha eno tzarich lehavi edim lo al haishsha velo al habbanim. meta veellu baneha tzarich lehavi edim sheellu banav. veeno tzarich lehavi edim al imman shehi keshera. mippene shekkevar huchzak sheyyatza meimmanu keishsha keshera: 
Yatza kohen meyuchas limdina acheret uva hu veishto uvanav veamar ishsha zo nasati veellu baneha tzarich lehavi reaya sheishsha zo keshera. veeno mevi edim sheellu baneha. vehu sheyyihyu keruchin achareha. veim ba bishte nashim vehevi reaya al haachat af al pi shehabbanim ketannim ucheruchin achareha tzarich lehavi reaya alehem shemma banav min haacheret hem venichrechu achar zo hameyucheset: 
Ba hu uvanav veamar ishsha nasati vameta veellu baneha mevi edim sheotah haishsha keshera hayta veellu baneha. vechaddin hazze danin beyisrael meyuchas uvelevi meyuchas. veachar kach naid al beno ze shehu meyuchas kede sheyyihye rauy lesanhedrin: 
En maalin mishshetarot lichhunna. ketzad. hare shehaya katuv bishtar peloni kohen lava mippeloni vehilvahu kach vechach vehaedim millematta en machazikin bahem kohen ze shehu meyuchas shemma lo heidu ella al hammilve. bamme devarim amurim leinyan yichus. aval lachazaka sheyyihye kohen kechohane zeman ze veyochal teruma vechalla shel divre sofrim uvishar kadshe haggevul maalin min hashshetarot veal pi ed echad uminnesiut kappayim umikkeria battora rishon: 
Vechen kol kohen sheamar beni ze kohen neeman lehaachilo bitruma velihyoto bechezkat kohen veeno tzarich lehavi reaya lo al habbanim velo al haishsha: 
Shenayim shebbau limdina ze omer ani vachaveri kohen veze omer ani vachaveri kohen af al pi shennirin kegomlin ze et ze hare ellu neemanin ushenehem bechezkat kohanim. vechen ed sheamar raiti ze shennasa kappav o sheachal bitruma o shechalak al haggoren o shekkara battora rishon vekara acharav levi machazikin oto bichhunna al piv. vechen im heid shezze kara sheni battora achar kohen machazikin oto bilviyya: 
Heid sheraa ze shechalak im achiv bevet din teruma shehinniach lahen avihen hakkohen en maalin oto lichhunna beedut zo. shemma chalal hu velakach chelek yerushshato mitteruma lemachrah: 
Mi shebba bazzeman hazze veamar kohen ani eno neeman veen maalin oto lichhunna al pi atzmo velo yikra battora rishon velo yissa et kappav velo yochal bekadshe haggevul ad sheyyihye lo ed echad. aval oser atzmo bigrusha vezona vachalala veeno mittamme lemetim. veim nasa o nitma loke. vehannivelet lo sefek chalala: 
Veim haya mesiach lefi tummo neeman. ketzad. maase beechad shehaya mesiach lefi tummo veamar zachur ani keshehayiti tinok vehayiti murkav al ketefo shel avi hotziuni mibbet hassefer vehifshituni kuttanti vehitbiluni leechol teruma laerev vachaveray bodlin mimmenni vehayu korin oti yochanan ochel challot veheelahu rabbenu hakkadosh lichhunna al pi atzmo: 
Neeman gadol lomar zachur ani keshehayiti tinok veraiti peloni tovel veochel bitruma laerev umachazikin oto bichhunna beeduto. mi shebba bazzeman hazze veamar kohen ani veed echad meid lo sheani yodea sheaviv shel ze kohen en maalin oto lichhunna beedut ze shemma chalal hu ad sheyyaid shezze kohen hu. aval im huchzak aviv kohen o shebbau shenayim veheidu sheaviv shel ze kohen hare hu bechezkat aviv: 
Mi shehuchzak aviv kohen veyatza alav kol shehu ben gerusha o chalutza choshshin lo umoridin oto. ba ed echad achar kach veheid shehu kasher maalin oto lichhunna al piv. bau shenayim edim achar kach vehaidu shehu chalal moridin oto min hakkehunna. ba ed echad veheid shehu kasher maalin oto lichhunna shezze haacharon mitztaref leed rishon vahare shenayim meidin shehu kasher ushenayim meidim shehu pasul yiddachu ellu veellu veyiddache hakkol shehashshenayim kemea veyishshaer kohen bechezkat aviv: 
Ishsha shello shahata shelosha chodashim achar balah veyalda. veen yadua im ben tisha lerishon o ben shiva leacharon vehaya echad mehen kohen vehashsheni yisrael hare ze sefek kohen. vechach im nitarev velad kohen bivlad yisrael vehigdilu hattaarovot kol echad mehen sefek kohen. venotnin alehen chumre yisrael vechumre kohanim. nosin nashim haruyot lichhunna veen mittammeim lemetim velo ochlin bitruma. veim nasu gerusha motziin veenan lokin: 
Shene kohanim shennitarvu valdotehem. o eshet kohen shello shahata achar balah shelosha chodashim venisset lechohen acher veen yadua im ben tisha larishon o ben shiva laacharon. notnin lo al havvalad chumre shenehem. hu onen alehem vehen onnin alav. hu en metamme lahem vehem enan metammein lo. veole bemishmaro shel ze veshel ze. veen cholek. veim hayu shenehem bemishmar echad uvet av echad notel chelek echad: 
Bamme devarim amurim bizman shehen bain mikkoach nissuin. aval biznut gazru chachamim shemmeshattekin oto middin kehunna kelal hoil veeno yodea aviv havvadday shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 25 13)</small> "vehayta lo ulezaro acharav" ad sheyyihye zaro meyuchas acharav: 
Ketzad. asara kohanim shepperash echad mehem uvaal shehare havvalad kohen vadday veaf al pi chen hoil veeno yodea aviv sheyyityaches lo meshattekin oto middin kehunna. veeno oved velo ochel velo cholek. veim nitma lemetim o nasa gerusha loke sheen kan sefek hetter:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 21:
Kol habba al erva min haarayot derech evarim o shechibbek venishshek derech taava venehena bekeruv basar hare ze loke min hattora. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 18 30)</small> "levilti asot mechukkot hattoevot" vegomer. veneemar <small>(Vayikra 18 6)</small> "lo tikrevu legallot erva". kelomar lo tikrevu lidvarim hammeviin lide gilluy erva: 
Haose davar mechukkot ellu hare hu chashud al haarayot. veasur laadam likrotz beyadav uveraglav o lirmoz beenav leachat min haarayot o lischok immah o lehakel rosh. vaafillu lehariach besamim shealeha o lehabbit beyafyah asur. umakkin lammitkavven ledavar ze makkat mardut. vehammistakkel afillu beetzba ketanna shel ishsha venitkavven lehanot kemi shennistakkel bimkom hattoref. vaafillu lishmoa kol haerva o lirot searah asur: 
Vehaddevarim haellu asurin bechayyave lavin. umuttar lehistakkel bifne happenuya ulevadkah ben betula ben beula kede sheyyire im hi naa beenav yissaenna veen baze tzad issur velo od ella sherauy laasot ken. aval lo yistakkel derech zenut. hare hu omer <small>(Iyov lo 1)</small> "berit karatti leenay uma etbonen al betula": 
Umuttar laadam lehabbit beishto keshehi nidda veaf al pi shehi erva. veaf al pi sheyyesh lo hanaat lev mimmenna biriyya hoil vehi mutteret lo leachar zeman eno ba baze lidvar michshol. aval lo yischok velo yakel rosh immah shemma yargil laavera: 
Asur lehishtamesh beishsha kelal ben gedola ben ketanna ben shifcha ben meshuchreret shemma yavo lide hirhur. bee ze shimmush amru rechitzat panav yadav veraglav vehatztzaat mitta lefanav umezigat hakkos. sheen osa leish devarim ellu ella ishto bilvad. veen shoalin bishlom ishsha kelal vaafillu al yede shaliach: 
Hamechabbek achat min haarayot sheen libbo shel adam nokfo alehen o shennishshek leachat mehen kegon achoto haggedola vaachot immo vechayyotze bahen af al pi sheen sham taava velo hanaa kelal hare ze megunne beyoter vedavar asur hu umaase tippeshim hu. sheen kerevin leerva kelal ben gedola ben ketanna chutz mehaem livnah vehaav levitto: 
Ketzad. muttar haav lechabbek bitto ulenashshekah vetishan immo bekeruv basar. vechen haem im benah kol zeman shehem ketannim. higdilu venaasa habben gadol vehabbat gedola ad sheyyihyu shadayim nachonu usearech tzamach ze yashen bichsuto vehi yeshena bichsutah. veim hayta habbat bosha laamod lifne aviha arumma o shennisset. vechen im haem bosha laamod bifne benah arumma veaf al pi shehen ketannim mishshehiggiu lehikkalem mehen en yeshenim immahem ella bichsutan: 
Nashim hamesolalot zo bazo asur umimmaase mitzrayim hu shehuzharnu alav shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 18 3)</small> "kemaase eretz mitzrayim lo taasu". amru chachamim me hayu osim ish nose ish veishsha nose ishsha. veishsha nisset lishne anashim. af al pi shemmaase ze asur en malkin alav. sheen lo lav meyuchad vahare en sham bia kelal. lefichach en neesarot lichhunna mishshum zenut velo teaser ishsha al balah baze sheen kan zenut. verauy lehakkotan makkat mardut hoil veasu issur. veyesh laish lehakepid al ishto middavar ze umonea hannashim hayeduot bechach millehikkanes lah umillatzet hi alehen: 
Ishto shel adam mutteret hi lo. lefichach kol ma sheadam rotze laasot beishto ose. boel bechol et sheyyirtze umenashshek bechol evar veevar sheyyirtze. [uva aleha kedarkah veshello kedarkah ] uvilvad shello yotzi shichvat zera levattala. veaf al pi chen middat chasidut shello yakel adam et rosho lechach vesheyyekaddesh atzmo bishat tashmish kemo shebbearnu behilchot deot. velo yasur midderech haolam uminhago sheen davar ze ella kede lifrot velirbot: 
Asur laadam leshammesh mittato leor hanner. hare shehayta shabbat velo haya lo bayit acher vehaya hanner daluk hare ze lo yeshammesh kelal. vechen asur leyisreeli leshammesh mittato bayyom. sheazzut panim hi lo. veim haya talmid chacham sheeno ba lehimmashech bechach hare ze maafil betallito umeshammesh. veen nizkakin ledavar ze ella mippene tzorech gadol. vederech kedushsha leshammesh beemtza hallayla: 
En daat chachamim nocha lemi shehu marbe battashmish hammitta veyihye matzuy etzel ishto ketarnegol. ufagum hu ad meod umaase burim hu. ella kol hamemaet battashmish hare ze meshubbach. vehu shello yevattel ona [ella] middaat ishto. velo tikkenu barishona levaale kerayin shello yikreu battora ad sheyyitbelu ella kede lemaet battashmish hammitta: 
Vechen asru chachamim shello yeshammesh adam mittato velibbo mechashshev beishsha acheret. velo yivol mittoch shichrut velo mittoch meriva velo mittoch sina velo yavo aleha al karchah vehi yerea mimmennu. velo kesheyyihye echad mehen menudde. velo yavo aleha achar sheggamar belibbo legarshah. veim asa ken habbanim enan hagunim ella mehen azze panim umehen mordim ufoshim: 
Vechen amru chachamim shekkol ishsha chatzufa shehi tovaat tashmish hammitta befiha. o hamefatte ishshah leshem nissuin. o hammitkavven lavo al rachel ishto uva al lea ishto. umi shello shahata achar mitat balah shelosha chodashim vahare habben safek. kol ellu habbanim hayyillodim mehem hem hammordim vehapposhim sheyyissure haggalut borrin otan: 
Veasur leadam lavo al ishto bashshevakim uvarchovot o baggannot uvappardesin ella bevet dira. shello yerae kiznut veyargilu atzmam lide zenut. vehabboel et ishto bimkomot ellu makkin oto makkat mardut. vechen hamekaddesh bevia vehamekaddesh bashshuk vehamekaddesh belo shidduch makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Veachsenay asur battashmish hammitta ad sheyyachzor leveto. vechen asru chachamim al haish sheyyadur bevet chamiv shezzo azzut panim hi. velo yikkanes immo lemerchatz: 
Velo yikkanes adam im aviv lammerchatz. velo im baal achoto. velo im talmido. veim haya tzarich letalmido muttar. veyesh mekomot shennahagu shello yikkansu shene achim keechad lammerchatz: 
Lo yehallechu benot yisrael perue rosh bashshuk. achat penuya veachat eshet ish. velo telech ishsha bashshuk uvenah achareha gezera shemma yitpesu benah vetelech acharav lehachaziro veyitallelu bah harshaim shettefasuhu derech sechok: 
Asur lehotzi shichvat zera levattala. lefichach lo yihye adam dash mibbifnim vezore mibbachutz. velo yissa ketanna sheenah reuya leled. aval ellu shemmenaafin bayyad umotziin shichvat zera lo day lahem sheissur gadol hu ella shehaose ze benidduy hu yoshev vaalehem neemar <small>(yeshaya 1 15)</small> "yedechem damim maleu" ucheillu harag hannefesh: 
Vechen asur leadam sheyyakshe atzmo ledaat o yavi atzmo lide hirhur. ella im yavo lo hirhur yassia libbo middivre havay (vehashechata) ledivre tora. shehi <small>(Mishlei 5 19)</small> "ayyelet ahavim veyaalat chen". lefichach asur leadam lishon al arpo ufanav lemala ad sheyyitte meat kede shello yavo lide kishshuy: 
Velo yistakkel bivhema uvechayya veof beshaa shemmizdakkin zachar linkeva. vmuttar lemarbie behema lehachenis kemichchol bishfoferet mippene shehen asukin bimlachtan lo yavou lide hirhur: 
Vechen asur leadam lehistakkel benashim beshaa shehen omdot al hakkevisa. afillu lehistakkel bevigde tzemer shel ishsha shehu makkirah asur. shello yavo lide hirhur: 
Mi sheppaga beishsha bashshuk asur lo lehallech achareha ella ratz umesallekah latztzedadin o leacharav. vechol hamehallech bashshuk achare ishsha hare ze mikkalle amme haaretz. veasur laavor al petach ishsha zona ad sheyyarchik arba ammot shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 5 8)</small> "veal tikrav el petach betah": 
Veasur leadam sheeno nasuy lishloach yado bimvushav shello yavo lide hirhur. vaafillu mittachat tibburo lo yachnis yado shemma yavo lide hirhur. veim hishtin mayim lo yeechoz baamma veyashtin. veim haya nasuy muttar. uven nasuy uven sheeno nasuy lo yoshit yado laamma kelal ella beshaa shehu tzarich linkavav: 
Chasidim harishonim ugedole hachachamim hitpaer echad mehem shemmeolam lo nistakkel bammila shello. umehen mi shehitpaer shello hitbonen meolam betzurat ishto. mippene shellibbo pone middivre havay ledivre haemet shehen ochazot levav hakkedoshim: 
Mitzvat chachamim sheyyassi adam banav uvenotav samuch lefirkan. sheim yannichan yavou lide zenut o lide hirhur. veal ze neemar <small>(Iyov 5 24)</small> "ufakadta navcha velo techeta". veasur lehassi ishsha lekatan shezze kemo zenut hi: 
Veen haish rashshay leshev belo ishsha. velo yissa akara uzekena sheenah reuya leled. ureshut laishsha shello tinnase leolam o tinnase lesaris. velo yissa bachur zekena velo yissa zaken yalda sheddavar ze gorem liznut: 
Vechen mi sheggeresh et ishto min hannissuin lo tadur immo bechatzer shemma yavou lide zenut. veim haya kohen lo tadur immo bemavoy. uchefar katan niddon kemavoy. haya lah milve etzlo osa shaliach letavo. ugerusha shebbaa im hamegaresh laddin menaddin otan o makkin otan makkat mardut. veim nitgarsha min haerusin mutteret letavo baddin veladur immo. veim haya libbo gas bah af min haerusin asur. umi nidche mippene mi hi niddechet mippanav. veim hayta hechatzer shellah hu yiddache mippaneha: 
Asur leadam lissa ishsha vedato legarshah shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 3 29)</small> "al tacharosh al reacha raa vehu yoshev lavetach ittach". veim hodia battechilla shehu nose otah leyamim muttar: 
Velo yissa adam ishsha bimdina zo veishsha bimdina acheret shemma yaarichu hayyamim venimtza ach nose achoto vaachot immo vaachot aviv vechayyotze bahen veeno yadua. veim haya adam gadol sheshshemo yadua vahare zaro mefursamin viduin hare ze muttar: 
Lo yissa adam ishsha mimmishpachat metzoraim velo mimmishpachat nichpin. vehu shehuchzeku shelosha peamim sheyyavou benehem kach: 
Ishsha shennisset lishne anashim vametu. lishlishi lo tinnase veim nisset lo tetze. vaafillu nitkaddesha yichnos. velo yissa yisrael am haaretz kohenet shezze kemo chillul lezaro shel aharon. veim nasa amru chachamim en ziuugan ole yafe ella met belo banim o met hu o hi bimhera o ketata tihye benehem. aval talmid chacham shennasa kohenet hare ze nae umeshubbach. hare tora uchehunna keechad: 
Lo yissa adam bat amme haaretz sheim met o gole banav amme haaretz yihyu sheen imman yodaat keter hattora. velo yassi bitto leam haaretz shekkol hannoten bitto leam haaretz kemiyi shekkefatah unetanah lifne haari makke uvoel veen lo boshet panim. uleolam yimkor adam kol ma sheyyesh lo veyissa bat talmid chacham sheim met o gole banav talmide chachamim. vechen yassi bitto letalmid chacham sheen davar megunne velo meriva beveto shel talmid chacham:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 22:
Asur lehityached im erva min haarayot ben zekena ben yalda sheddavar ze gorem legallot erva. chutz mehaem im benah vehaav im bitto vehabbaal im ishto nidda. vechatan sheppersa ishto nidda kodem sheyyivol asur lehityached immah ella hi yeshena ben hannashim vehu yashen ben haanashim. veim ba aleha bia rishona veachar kach nitmet muttar lehityached immah: 
Lo nechshedu yisrael al mishkav zachur veal habbehema. lefichach en asur lehityached immahen. veim nitrachek afillu miyyichud zachur uvehema hare ze meshubbach. ugedole hachachamim hayu marchikin habbehema kede shello yityachadu immah. veissur yichud haarayot mippi hakkabbala: 
Kesheera maase amnon vetamar gazar david uvet dino al yichud penuya. veaf al pi sheenah erva bichlal yichud arayot hi. veshammay vehillel gazru al yichud kutit. nimtza kol hammityached im ishsha sheasur lehityached immah ben yisreelit ben kutit makkin et shenehen makkat mardut haish vehaishsha. umachrizin alehen. chutz meeshet ish sheaf al pi sheasur lehityached immah im nityached en lokin. shello lehotzi laaz aleha shezzinneta venimtzeu motziin laaz al habbanim shehen mamzerim: 
Kol ishsha sheasur lehityached immah im hayta ishto immo hare zo mutteret lehityached mippene sheishto meshammarto. aval lo tityached yisreelit im hakkuti veaf al pi sheishto immo sheen ishto shel kuti meshammarto veen lahen busha: 
Vechen en mosrin tinok yisrael lechuti lelammedo sefer ulelammedo ammanut. mippene shekkullan chashudin al mishkav zachur. veen maamidin behema befundakiyyot shel kutim vaafillu zecharim etzel zecharim unekevot etzel nekevot: 
Veen mosrin behema chayya veof leroe kuti afillu zecharim lechutim unekevot lechutit mippene shekkullan chashudin al harebaat behema uchevar bearnu shehen asurin bezachur uvivhema veneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 14)</small> "velifne ivver lo titten michshl": 
Umippene ma en mosrin behema nekeva lechutit mippene shekkullan bechezkat noafim uchesheyyavo hannoef lishkav im hakkutit zo efshar shello yimtzaenna veyishkav im habbehema o afillu yimtzaenna yishkav im habbehema: 
Lo tityached ishsha achat afillu im anashim harebe ad shettihye ishto shel echad mehem sham. vechen lo yityached ish echad afillu im nashim harebe. nashim harebe im anashim harebe en choshshin leyichud. hayu haanashim mibbachutz vehannashim mibbifnim o haanashim mibbifnim vehannashim mibbachutz ufersha ishsha achat leven haanashim o ish leven hannashim asurin mishshum yichud. afillu ish sheisko umelachto im hannashim asur lo lehityached im hannashim. ketzad yaase. yitassek immahen veishto immo o yifne limlacha acheret: 
Muttar lehityached im shete yevamot. o im shete tzarot. o im ishsha vachamotah. o im ishsha uvat balah. o im ishsha uvat chamotah. mippene shessonot zo et zo veen mechappot zo al zo. vechen muttar lehityached im ishsha sheyyesh immah tinoket ketanna sheyyodaat taam bia veenah moseret atzmah levia. sheenah mezanna befaneha shehare zo megalla et sodah: 
Tinoket mibbat shalosh ulematta vetinok ben tesha ulematta muttar lehityached immahen. shello gazru ella al yichud ishsha haruya levia veish harauy levia: 
Anderoginus eno mityached im hannashim. veim nityached en makkin oto mippene shehu safek. aval haish mityached im haanderoginus veim hattumtum: 
Eshet ish shehaya balah bair enah chosheshet leyichud. mippene sheemat balah aleha. veim haya ze gas bah kegon sheggadla immo o shehayta kerovato lo yityached immah veaf al pi shebbalah bair. vechen kol hammityached im ishsha vehaya happetach patuach lirshut harabbim en choshshin mishshum yichud: 
Mi sheen lo ishsha lo yelammed tinokot. mippene sheimmot habbanim baot levet hassefer livnehem venimtza mitgare benashim. vechen ishsha lo telammed ketannim mippene avotehen shehen bain biglal benehem venimtzeu mityachadim immah. veen hamelammed tzarich shettihye ishto sheruya immo bevet hassefer ella hi bevetah vehu melammed bimkomo: 
Tikkenu chachamim shettihyena hannashim mesapperot zo im zo bevet hakkisse kede shello yikkanes sham ish mishshum yichud: 
En memannin afillu adam neeman vechasher lihyot shomer chatzer sheyyesh sham nashim af al pi shehu omed bachutz sheen appotroppos laarayot. veasur leadam lemannot appotroppos al beto shello yanhig ishto lidvar avera: 
Asur letalmid chacham lishkon bechatzer sheyyesh bah almana af al pi sheeno mityached immah mippene hachashad. ella im ken hayta ishto immo. vechen almana asura legaddel kelev mippene hachashad. velo tikne ishsha avadim zecharim afillu ketannim mippene hachashad: 
En dorshin besitre arayot bishlosha mippene shehaechad tarud bishelat harav vehashshenayim nosin venotnin ze im ze veen datam penuya lishmoa. sheddato shel adam kerova etzel arayot. im nistappek lo davar sheshshama more lehakel. lefichach en dorshin ella lishnayim kede sheyyihye haechad hashshomea mefanne dato veyodea ma sheyyishma min harav: 
En lecha davar bechol hattora kullah shehu kashe lerov haam lifrosh ella min haarayot vehabbiot haasurot. amru chachamim beshaa shennitztauu yisrael al haarayot bachu vekibbelu mitzva zo betaromot uvechiyya shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 11 10)</small> "boche lemishpechotav" al iske mishpachot: 
Veamru chachamim gezel vaarayot nafsho shel adam mitavva lahen umechammedatan. veen atta motze kahal bechol zeman uzeman sheen bahen perutzin baarayot uviot asurot. [veod] amru chachamim rov begezel miut baarayot vehakkol baavak lashon hara: 
Lefichach rauy lo leadam lachof yitzro bedavar ze ulehargil atzmo bikdushsha yetera uvemachashava tehora uvedea nechona kede lehinnatzel mehen. veyizzaher min hayyichud shehu haggorem haggadol. gedole hachachamim hayu omrim letalmidehem hizzaharu bi mippene bitti hizzaharu bi mippene kallati. kede lelammed letalmidehem shello yitbayyeshu middavar ze veyitrachaku min hayyichud: 
Vechen yinhog lehitrachek min hassechok umin hashshichrut umiddivre agavim sheellu gormin gedolim vehem maalot shel arayot. velo yeshev belo ishsha shemminhag ze gorem letohora yetera. gedola mikkol zot amru yafne atzmo umachashavto ledivre tora veyarchiv dato bachachma sheen machshevet arayot mitgabberet ella belev panuy min hachachma. uvachachma hu omer <small>(Mishlei 5 19)</small> "ayyelet ahavim veyaalat chen daddeha yeravvecha vechol et beahavatah tishge tamid":
Mishneh Torah, Foreign Worship and Custo: Vime enosh tau bene haadam taut gadol venivara atzat chachme oto haddor veenosh atzmo min hattoim haya. vezo hayta tautam. amru hoil vehaelohim bara kochavim ellu vegalgallim lehanehig et haolam unetanam bammarom vechalak lahem kavod vehem shammashim hameshammeshim lefanav reuyin hem leshabbecham ulefaaram velachalok lahem kavod. vezehu retzon hael baruch hu legaddel ulechabbed mi sheggiddelo vechibbedo. kemo shehammelech rotze lechabbed haomdim lefanav vezehu kevodo shel melech. kevan sheala davar ze al libbam hitchilu livnot lakkochavim hechalot ulehakriv lahen karbanot uleshabbecham ulefaaram bidvarim ulehishtachavot lemulam kede lehassig retzon habbore bedatam haraa. veze haya ikkar avodat kochavim. vechach hayu omrim ovdeha hayyodim ikkarah. lo shehen omrim sheen sham eloah ella kochav ze. hu sheyyirmeyahu omer mi lo yiraacha melech haggoyim ki lecha yaata ki vechol chachme haggoyim uvechol malchutam meen kamocha uveachat yivaru veyichsalu musar havalim etz hu. kelomar hakkol yodim sheatta hu levaddecha aval tautam uchesilutam shemmedammim shezze hahevel retzoncha hu:

Veachar shearchu hayyamim amdu bivne haadam nevie sheker veamru shehael tzivva veamar lahem ivdu kochav peloni o kol hakkochavim vehakerivu lo venassechu lo kach vechach uvenu lo hechol vaasu tzurato kede lehishtachavot lo kol haam hannashim vehakketannim ushear amme haaretz. umodia lahem tzura shebbada millibbo veomer zo hi tzurat hakkochav peloni shehodiuhu binvuato. vehitchilu al derech zo laasot tzurot bahechalot vetachat hailanot uverashe heharim veal haggevaot umitkabbetzin umishtachavim lahem veomrim lechol haam shezzo hatztzura metiva umerea verauy leavdah uleyira mimmenna. vechohanehem omrim lahem shebbaavoda zo tirbu vetatzlichu vaasu kach vechach veal taasu kach vechach. vehitchilu kozvim acherim laamod velomar shehakkochav atzmo o haggalgal o hammalach dibber immahem veamar lahem ivduni bechach vechach vehodia lahem derech avodato vaasu kach veal taasu kach. ufashat davar ze bechol haolam laavod et hatztzurot baavodot meshunnot zo mizzo ulehakriv lahem ulehishtachavot. vechevan shearchu hayyamim nishtakkach hashshem hannichbad vehannora mippi kol hayekum umiddatam velo hikkiruhu venimtzeu kol am haaretz hannashim vehakketannim enam yodim ella hatztzura shel etz veshel even vehahechol shel avanim shennitchannechu mikkatnutam lehishtachavot lah uleavdah ulehishshava bishmah. vehachachamim shehayu bahem kegon kohanehem vechayyotze bahen medammin sheen sham eloah ella hakkochavim vehaggalgallim shennaasu hatztzurot haellu biglalam uledammotan. aval tzur haolamim lo haya shum adam shehaya makkiro velo yodo ella yechidim baolam kegon chanoch umetushelach noach shem veever. veal derech ze haya haolam holech umitgalgel ad shennolad ammudo shel olam vehu avraham avinu:

Kevan shennigmal etan ze hitchil leshotet bedato vehu katan vehitchil lachashov bayyom uvallayla vehaya tameah heach efshar sheyyihye haggalgal hazze noheg tamid velo yihye lo manhig umi yesabbev oto. ki i efshar sheyyesabbev et atzmo. velo haya lo melammed velo modia davar ella mushka beur kasdim ben ovde kochavim hattippeshim veaviv veimmo vechol haam ovde kochavim vehu oved immahem velibbo meshotet umevin ad shehissig derech haemet vehevin kav hatztzedek mittevunato hannechona. veyada sheyyesh sham eloah echad vehu manhig haggalgal vehu bara hakkol veen bechol hannimtza eloah chutz mimmennu. veyada shekkol haolam toim vedavar sheggaram lahem litot ze sheovdim et hakkochavim veet hatztzurot ad sheavad haemet middatam. uven arbaim shana hikkir avraham et boro. kevan shehikkir veyada hitchil lehashiv teshuvot al bene ur kasdim velaaroch din immahem velomar sheen zo derech haemet sheattem holchim bah veshibber hatztzelamim vehitchil lehodia laam sheen rauy laavod ella leeloah haolam velo rauy lehishtachavot ulehakriv ulenassech kede sheyyakkiruhu kol habberuim habbaim. verauy leabbed uleshabber kol hatztzurot kede shello yitu bahen kol haam kemo ellu shehem medammim sheen sham eloah ella ellu. kevan sheggavar alehem birayotav bikkesh hammelech lehargo venaasa lo nes veyatza lecharan. vehitchil laamod velikro bekol gadol lechol haolam ulehodiam sheyyesh sham eloah echad lechol haolam velo rauy laavod. vehaya mehallech vekore umekabbetz haam meir leir umimmamlacha lemamlacha ad shehiggia leeretz kenaan vehu kore shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 21 33)</small> "vayyikra sham beshem Adonai el olam". vechevan shehayu haam mitkabbetzin elav veshoalin lo al devarav haya modia lechol echad veechad kefi dato ad sheyyachzirehu lederech haemet ad shennitkabbetzu elav alafim urevavot vehem anshe bet avraham veshatal belibbam haikkar haggadol hazze vechibber bo sefarim vehodio leyitzchak beno. veyashav yitzchak melammed umazhir. veyitzchak hodia leyaakov uminnahu lelammed veyashav melammed umachazik kol hannilvim elav. veyaakov avinu limmed banav kullam vehivdil levi uminnahu rosh vehoshivo bishiva lelammed derech hashshem velishmor mitzvat avraham. vetzivva et banav shello yafsiku mibbene levi memunne achar memunne kede shello tishshachach hallimmud. vehaya haddavar holech umitgabber bivne yaakov uvannilvim alehem venaaset baolam umma shehi yodaat et Adonai. ad shearchu hayyamim leyisrael bemitzrayim vechazru lilmod maasehen velaavod kochavim kemotan chutz mishshevet levi sheamad bemitzvat avot. umeolam lo avad shevet levi avodat kochavim. vechimat kat haya haikkar sheshshatal avraham neekar vechozrin bene yaakov letaut haolam uteiyyotan. umeahavat Adonai otanu umishshamro et hashshevua leavraham avinu asa moshe rabbenu rabban shel kol hanneviim ushelacho. kevan shennitnabbe moshe rabbenu uvachar Adonai yisrael lenachala hichtiran bemitzvot vehodiam derech avodato uma yihye mishpat avodat kochavim vechol hattoim achareha:

Ikkar hatztziuuy baavodat kochavim shello laavod echad mikkol habberuim lo malach velo galgal velo kochav velo echad mearbaa hayesodot velo echad mikkol hannivraim mehen. veaf al pi shehaoved yodea she hu haelohim vehu oved hannivra hazze al derech sheavad enosh veanshe doro techilla hare ze oved kochavim. veinyan ze hu shehizhira tora alav veamra <small>(Devarim 4 19)</small> "ufen tissa enecha hashshamayma veraita et hashshemesh" vegomer <small>(Devarim 4 19)</small> "asher chalak Adonai elohecha otam lechol haammim". kelomar shemma tashut been libbecha vetire sheellu hen hammanhigim et haolam vehem shechalak Adonai otam lechol haolam lihyot chayyim vehovim veenam nifsadim keminhago shel olam vetomar sherauy lehishtachavot lahem uleavdan. uvainyan hazze tzivva veamar <small>(Devarim 11 16)</small> "hishshamru lachem pen yifte levavchem". kelomar shello titteu behirhur hallev laavod ellu lihyot sarsur benechem uven habbore:

Sefarim rabbim chibberu ovde kochavim baavodatah heach ikkar avodatah uma maaseha umishpateha. tzivvanu hakkadosh baruch hu shello likrot beotan hassefarim kelal velo neharher bah velo bedavar middevareha. vaafillu lehistakkel bidmut hatztzura asur shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 4)</small> "al tifnu el haelilim". uvainyan hazze neemar <small>(Devarim 12 30)</small> "ufen tidrosh lelohehem lemor echa yaavdu", shello tishal al derech avodatah heach hi af al pi sheen atta ovdah, sheddavar ze gorem lehippanot achareha velaasot kema shehen osin shenneemar veeese ken gam ani:

Vechol hallavin haellu beinyan echad hen vehu shello yifne achar avodat kochavim vechol hannifne achareha bederech shehu ose bo maase hare ze loke. velo avodat kochavim bilvad hu sheasur lehippanot achareha bemachashava ella kol machashava shehu gorem lo laadam laakor ikkar meikkere hattora muzharin anu shello lehaalotah al libbenu velo nassiach datenu lechach venachshov venimmashech achar hirhure hallev. mippene sheddato shel adam ketzara velo kol haddeot yecholin lehassig haemet al buryo. veim yimmashech kol adam achar machshevot libbo nimtza machariv et haolam lefi kotzer dato. ketzad. peamim yatur achar avodat kochavim ufeamim yachshov beyichud habbore shemma hu shemma eno. ma lemala uma lematta ma lefanim uma leachor. ufeamim bannevua shemma hi emet shemma hi enah. ufeamim battora shemma hi min hashshamayim shemma enah. veeno yodea hammiddot sheyyadin bahen ad sheyyeda haemet al buryo venimtza yotze lide minut. veal inyan ze hizhira tora veneemar bah <small>(Bamidbar 15 39)</small> "velo taturu achare levavchem veachare enechem asher attem zonim". kelomar lo yimmashech kol echad mikkem achar dato hakketzara vidamme shemmachashavto masseget haemet. kach amru chachamim <small>(gemara berachot 12 2)</small> "achare levavchem zo minut" veachare enechem zo zenut. velav ze af al pi shehu gorem laadam letardo min haolam habba en bo malkot:

Mitzvat avodat kochavim keneged hammitzvot kullan hi shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 22)</small> "vechi tishgu velo taasu et kol hammitzvot" vegomer umippi hashshemua lamdu shebbaavodat kochavim hakkatuv medabber. ha lamadta shekkol hammode baavodat kochavim kofer bechol hattora kullah uvechol hanneviim uvechol ma shennitztauu hanneviim meadam vead sof haolam shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 23)</small> "min hayyom asher tzivva Adonai vahala ledorotechem". vechol hakkofer baavodat kochavim mode bechol hattora kullah uvechol hanneviim uvechol ma shennitztauu hanneviim meadam vead sof haolam vehu ikkar kol hammitzvot kullan:

Yisrael sheavad avodat kochavim hare hu keoved kochavim lechol devarav veeno keyisrael sheover avera sheyyesh bah sekila. mumar laavodat kochavim hare hu mumar lechol hattora kullah. vechen haeppikorsim miyyisrael enan keyisrael ledavar min haddevarim veen mekabbelim otam bitshuva leolam shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 2 19)</small> "kol baeha lo yeshuvun velo yassigu archot chayyim". vehaeppikorsim hem hattarim achar machshevot libbam besichlut devarim sheamarnu ad shennimtzeu ovrim al gufe tora lehacheis bishat nefesh beyad rama veomrim sheen baze avon. veasur lesapper immahen ulehashiv alehen teshuva kelal shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 5 8)</small> "veal tikrav el petach betah". umachashava shel eppikoros laavodat kochavim:

Kol hammode baavodat kochavim shehi emet af al pi shello avadah hare ze mecharef umegaddef et hashshem hannichbad vehannora. veechad haoved avodat kochavim veechad hamegaddef et Adonai shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 30)</small> "vehannefesh asher taase beyad rama min haezrach umin hagger et Adonai hu megaddef". lefichach tolin oved avodat kochavim kemo shettolin et hamegaddef ushenehem niskalin. umippene ze kalalti din hamegaddef behilchot avodat kochavim sheshshenehem kofrim baikkar hem:

Veellu hen dine hamegaddef. en hamegaddef chayyav sekila ad sheyyefaresh et hashshem hameyuchad shel arba otiyyot shehu alef dalet nun yod vivarech oto beshem min hashshemot sheenam nimchakim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 24 16)</small> "venokev shem Adonai", al hashshem hameyuchad chayyav sekila veal shear hakkinnuyim beazhara. veyesh mi shemmefaresh sheeno chayyav ella al shem yod hei vav hei vaani omer sheal shenehem hu niskal:

Azhara shel megaddef minnayin shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 27)</small> "elohim lo tekallel". bechol yom vayom bodkin et haedim bechinnuyim yakke yosi et yosi. nigmar haddin motziin et kol adam lachutz veshoalim et haggadol shebbaedim veomrim lo emor ma sheshshamata beferush vehu omer vehaddayyanim omdim al raglehem vekorin velo meachin. vehaed hashsheni omer af ani kemoto shamati. veim hayu edim rabbim tzarich kol echad veechad mehen lomar kaze shamati:

Megaddef shechazar bo betoch kede dibbur eno kelum ella kevan sheggiddef beedim niskal. mi sheggiddef et hashshem beshem avodat kochavim kannaim pogim bo vehorgim oto. veim lo haraguhu kannaim uva levet din eno niskal ad sheyyevarech beshem min hashshemot hameyuchadim:

Kol hashshomea birkat hashshem chayyav likroa vaafillu al birkat hakkinnuyin chayyav likroa vehu sheyyishmaenna miyyisrael. echad hashshomea veechad hashshomea mippi hashshomea chayyav likroa. aval hashshomea mippi haoved kochavim eno chayyav likroa. velo karu elyakim veshevna ella mippene sheravshake haya yisrael mumar. kol haedim vehaddayyanim somchim et yedehem echad echad al rosh hamegaddef veomer lo damcha beroshcha sheatta garamta lecha. veen bechol haruge bet din mi shessomchim alav ella megaddef bilvad shenneemar vesamchu chol hashshomim et yedehem:
Kol haoved kochavim birtzono bezadon chayyav karet veim hayu sham edim vehateraa niskal. veim avad bishgaga mevi karban chattat kevua:

Avodot harebe kavu ovde kochavim lechol tzelem vetzelem ulechol tzura vetzura vaavodat ze enah kaavodat ze kegon peor sheavodato sheppoer adam atzmo lo umarkulis sheavodato sheyyizrok lo avanim o yesakkel millefanav avanim veharebe avodot kegon ellu tikkenu lishar tzelamim. lefichach happoer atzmo lemarkulis o shezzarak even lifor patur ad sheyyaavod oto derech avodato shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 30)</small> "echa yaavdu haggoyim haelle et elohehem veeese ken gam ani". umippene ze hainyan tzerichin bet din leda darche haavodot, sheen soklin oved kochavim ad sheyyedu shezzo hi derech avodato:

Veazhara shel avodot ellu vechayyotze bahen hu ma shekkatuv <small>(Shemot 20 5)</small> "velo taavdem". bamme devarim amurim bishar avodot chutz mimmishtachav vezoveach umaktir umenassech. aval haoved beachat meavodot ellu leechad mikkol mine avodat kochavim chayyav veaf al pi sheen derech avodato bechach. ketzad. hare shennissech lifor o shezzavach lemarkulis chayyav shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 19)</small> "zoveach laelohim yochoram bilti laAdonai levaddo". zevicha bichlal avoda hayta velamma yatzat lomar lecha ma zevicha meyuchedet sheovdin bah lashshem vechayyav hazzoveach leel acher sekila aleha ben hayta derech avodato bizvicha o enah bizvicha. af kol avoda shehi meyuchedet lashshem im avad bah leel acher ben shehayta derech avodato bechach ben sheenah bechach chayyav aleha. lechach neemar <small>(Shemot 34 14)</small> "lo tishtachave leel acher" lechayyev al hahishtachavaya afillu en derech avodato bechach. vehu haddin limkatter umenassech. vezorek umenassech echad hu:

Safat lah tzoa o shennissech lah avit shel me raglayim chayyav. shachat lah chagav patur ella im ken hayta avodatah bechach. vechen im shachat lah behema mechusseret evar patur ella im ken hayta derech avodatah bechach. avodat kochavim sheovdin otah bemakkel. shavar makkel befaneha chayyav veneeseret. zarak makkel befaneha chayyav veenah neeseret. sheen zerikat hammakkel keen zerikat haddam shehare hammakkel kemo shehu vehaddam mitpazzer. hamekabbel alav echad mikkol mine avodat kochavim beloah chayyav sekila. vaafillu higbiah levena veamar lah eli atta vechen kol kayyotze bedibbur ze chayyav. vaafillu chazar bo betoch kede dibbur veamar en ze eli en chazarato kelum ella niskal:

Haoved avodat kochavim kedarkah vaafillu asa derech bizzayon chayyav. ketzad. happoer atzmo lifor kede levazzoto o zarak even lemarkulis kede levazzoto hoil vaavodato bechach chayyav. umevi karban al shiggato:

Haoved avodat kochavim meahava kegon shechashak betzura zo mippene melachtah shehayta naa beyoter. o sheavadah miyyirato lah shemma tarea lo kemo shehen medammim ovdeha shehi metiva umerea. im kibbelah alav beloah chayyav sekila veim avadah derech avodatah o beachat mearba avodot meahava o miyyira patur. hamegappef avodat kochavim vehamenashshek lah vehamechabbed vehamerabbetz lefaneha vehammarchitz lah vehassach vehammalbish vehammanil vechol kayyotze bedivre kavod haellu over belo taase shenneemar velo taavdem, udevarim ellu bichlal avoda hen. veaf al pi chen eno loke al achat mehen lefi sheenan beferush. veim hayta derech avodatah beechad mikkol haddevarim haellu vaasahu leavdah chayyav:

Yashav lo kotz beraglo lifne avodat kochavim lo yashoach veyittelennu mippene shennire kemishtachave lah. nitpazzeru lo maot befaneha lo yashoach veyittelem mippene shennire kemishtachave lah ella yeshev veachar kach yittol:
Partzufot hamekallechot mayim bifne avodat kochavim lo yanniach piv al pihem veyishte mippene shennire kimnashshek laavodat kochavim:

Haose avodat kochavim leatzmo af al pi shello asaah beyado velo avadah loke shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 4)</small> "lo taase lecha fesel vechol temuna". vechen haose avodat kochavim beyado laacherim afillu asaah leoved kochavim loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 4)</small> "velohe massecha lo taasu lachem". lefichach haose avodat kochavim beyado leatzmo loke shetayim:

Asur laasot tzurot lenoy veaf al pi sheenah avodat kochavim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 20)</small> "lo taasun itti" kelomar tzurot shel kesef vezahav sheenam ella lenoy kede shello yitteu bahen hattoim vidammu shehem laavodat kochavim. veen issur latzur lenoy ella tzurat haadam bilvad. lefichach en metzayyerim lo beetz velo besid velo beeven tzurat haadam. vehu shettihye hatztzura boletet kegon hatztziyyur vehakkiyyur shebbatteraklin vechayyotze bahen veim tzar loke. aval im hayita hatztzura mushkaat o tzura shel sammanin kegon hatztzurot sheal gabbe halluchot vihattavliyyot o tzurot sherokmin baarig hare ellu muttarot:

Tabbaat sheyyesh aleha chotam shehu tzurat adam im hayta hatztzura boletet asur lehannichah umuttar lachtom bah. veim hayta hatztzura shokaat muttar lehannichah veasur lachtom bah mippene shehannachatam taase bo hatztzura boletet. vechen asur latzur demut chamma ulevana kochavim mazzalot umalachim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 20)</small> "lo taasun itti" <small>(gemara rosh hashshana kad 2)</small> "lo taasun kidmut shemashay hameshammeshin lefanay bammarom" vaafillu al halluach. tzurot habbehemot ushear nefesh chayya chutz min haadam vetzurot hailanot udeshaim vechayyotze bahen muttar latzur otam vaafillu hayta hatztzura boletet:

Maddiche ir miyyisrael hare ellu niskalin af al pi shello avdu avodat kochavim ella hiddichu et yoshve iram ad sheavdu otah. veanshe hair hammuddachin neheragin besayif vehu sheavdu avodat kochavim o shekkibbeluha alehem beeloah. veazhara lammaddiach minnayin shenneemar lo yishshama al picha:

En hair naaset ir hanniddachat ad sheyyihyu maddicheha mittochah umeoto hashshevet shenneemar mikkirbecha <small>(Devarim 13 14)</small> "vayyaddichu et yoshve iram". vead sheyyihyu maddicheha shenayim o yeter al shenayim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 14)</small> "yatzu anashim bene veliyyaal vayyaddichu et yshve iram". vead sheyyaddichu rubbah. veyihyu hammuddachin mimmea vead rubbo shel shevet. aval im huddach rubbo shel shevet danin otam kichidim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 16)</small> "yshve hair" lo kefar katan velo kerach gadol. vechol pachot mimmea kefar katan. verubbo shel shevet kerach gadol. vechen im hiddichuha nashim o ketannim o shehiddichah yachid o shehuddecha miutah o shehuddechu mealehen o shehayu maddicheha michutza lah en danin bah din ir hanniddachat ella hare hen kichidim sheavdu avodat kochavim vesoklin kol mi sheavad umamonan leyorshehen kishar haruge bet din:

En danin ir hanniddachat ella bevet din shel echad veshivim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 5)</small> "vehotzeta et haish hahu o et haishsha hahi asher asu et haddavar hara hazze el shearecha", yechidim neheragim bevet din shel kol shaar veshaar veen hamerubbim neheragin ella bevet din haggadol:

En achat meare miklat naaset ir hanniddachat shenneemar (0 "beachad shearecha") [beachat arecha]. velo yerushalayim naaset ir hanniddachat lefi shello nitchalleka lishvatim. veen osin ir hanniddachat bassefar kede shello yikkansu ovde kochavim veyacharivu et eretz yisrael. veen bet din echad ose shalosh ayarot hanniddachot zo betzad zo. aval im hayu meruchakot ose:

En osin ir hanniddachat ad sheyyaddichuha maddicheha bilshon rabbim veyomru lahen nelech venaavod o nelech venizbach o nelech venaktir o nelech unenassech o nelech venishtachave o nelech unekabbel beeloah vehem shomim veavdu otah derech avodatah o beachat mearba avodot o shekkibbeluha beloah. ir hanniddachat shello nitkayyemu bah uvemaddicheha kol hattenaim haellu heach osim lahem, matrin umeidin bechol echad veechad mehen sheavad avodat kochavim vesoklin otam kichidim sheavdu umamonam leyorshehem:

Veheach din ir hanniddachat. bizman shettihye reuya leheasot ir hanniddachat. bet din haggadol sholchin vedorshin vechokrin ad sheyyedu biraya berura shehuddecha kol hair o rubbah vechazru laavodat kochavim. achar kach sholchim lahem shene talmide chachamim lehazehiram ulehachaziram. im chazru veasu teshuva mutav veim yaamdu beivvaltan bet din metzavvin lechol yisrael laalot alehen latztzava vehen tzarin alehem veorchin immahen milchama ad shettibbaka hair. keshettibbaka miyyad marbin lahem batte dinin vedanim otam. kol mi shebbau alav shene edim sheavad kochavim achar shehitru oto mafrishin oto. nimtzeu kol haovdim miutah soklin otan ushear hair nitztzol. nimtzeu rubbah maalin otan levet din haggadol vegomrin sham dinam vehorgin kol ellu sheavdu besayif. umakkin et kol nefesh adam asher bah lefi charev taf venashim im huddecha kullah. veim nimtzeu haovdim rubbah makkim et kol hattaf venashim shel ovdim lefi charev. uven shehuddecha kullah ben shehuddecha rubbah soklin et maddicheha umekabbetzin kol shelalah el toch rechovah. en lah rechov osin lah rechov. haya rechovah chutza lah bonin choma chutz mimmennu ad sheyyikkanes letochah shenneemar el toch rechovah. vehorgin kol nefesh chayya asher bah vesorfin et kol shelalah im hammedina baesh. userefatah mitzvat ase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 17)</small> "vesarafta vaesh et hair veet kol shelalah":

Nichse hatztzaddikim shebbetochah vehem shear yoshve hair shello huddechu im rubbah nisrafin bichlal shelalah hoil veyashvu sham mamonan avad. vechol hannehene mimmenna bechol shehu loke achat shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 18)</small> "velo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem":

Veir hanniddachat shehuzemu edeha kol hammachazik binchaseha zacha umuttar lehanot bo shehare huzemu. velamma zacha bah shekkol echad veechad kevar hifkir mamono mishshaa shennigmar dino. veenah nivnet leolam vechol habbone otah loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 17)</small> "lo tibbane od". umuttar laasotah ginnot ufardesim shenneemar lo tibbane od lo tibbane medina kemo shehayta:
Shayyara haoveret mimmakom lemakom im avra bair hanniddachat vehuddecha immah. im shahata sham sheloshim yom neheragin besayif umamonam aved veim lav hen biskila umamonam leyorshehen:

Nichse anshe medina acheret shehayu mufkadin betochah af al pi shekkibbelu alehen acharayut en nisrafin ella yachzeru levaalehen shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 17)</small> "shelalah" velo shelal chavertah. nichse harshaim shehuddechu shehayu mufkadin bimdina acheret im nikbetzu immah nisrafin bichlalah veim lav en meabbedim otam ella yinnatnu leyorshehem:
Behema chetzyah shel ir hanniddachat vechetzyah shel ir acheret shehayta betochah hare zo asura. veissa shehi ken mutteret lefi sheefshar lechallekah:

Behema shel ir hanniddachat shennishchata asura bahanaa keshor hanniskal shennishchat. sear harosh ben shel anashim ben shel nashim shebbah muttar bahanaa aval shel pea nachrit hare hu mikkelal shelalah veasur:

Perot hamechubbarin shebbetochah muttarin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 17)</small> "tikbotz" <small>(Devarim 13 17)</small> "vesarafta" mi sheeno mechussar ella kibbutz userefa yatzu perot hamechubbarin shehen mechussarin telisha vekibbutz userefa. vehu haddin lisar harosh veen tzarich lomar hailanot atzman shehen muttarim vahare hen shel yorshehem. hahekdeshot shebbetochah kadshe mizbeach yamutu [shenneemar] zevach reshaim toeva. kadshe bedek habbayit yippadu veachar kach sorfin otan shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 17)</small> "shelalah" velo shelal shamayim:

Habbechor vehammaaser shebbetochah temimim hare hen kadshe mizbeach veyamutu. uvaale mumim hare hen bichlal behemtah veneheragin. hatterumot shebbetochah im higgiu leyad kohen yerakvu mippene shehem nechasav. veim adayin hen beyad yisrael yinnatnu lechohen shel medina acheret mippene shehen nichse shamayim ukedushshatan kedushshat hagguf:
Maaser sheni vechesef maaser sheni vechitve hakkodesh shebbetochah hare ellu yigganzu:

Kol haose din beir hanniddachat hare ze kemakriv ola kalil shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 17)</small> "kalil laAdonai elohecha". velo od ella shemmesallek charon af miyyisrael shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 18)</small> "lemaan yashuv Adonai mecharon appo". umevi alehem beracha verachamim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 18)</small> "venatan lecha rachamim verichamcha vehirbecha":

Hammesit echad miyyisrael ben ish ben ishsha hare ze niskal af al pi shello avad hammesit velo hammusat avodat kochavim ella mippene shehorahu laavod. ben shehaya hammesit hedyot ben shehaya navi ben shehaya hammusat yachid ish o ishsha o yechidim mitato biskila:

Hammesit et rov anshe hair hare ze maddiach veeno nikra mesit. haya ze shehiddiach rov hair navi mitato biskila vehanniddachim hare hen kichidim veenam keanshe ir hanniddachat ad sheyyihyu hammaddichim shenayim. veechad haomer amra li avodat kochavim ivduha. o sheamar amar li hakkadosh baruch hu ivdu avodat kochavim hare ze navi shehiddiach. veim huddechu acharav rov hair niskal. hammesit shehesit ben bilshon rabbim ben bilshon yachid hare ze niskal. ketzad. haomer lachavero eevod kochavim elech veeevod nelech venaavod baavoda pelonit shedderech otah avodat kochavim leheaved bah. ezbach elech veezbach nelech venizbach. akatter elech vaakater nelech unekatter. anassech elech vaanassech nelech unenassech. eshtachave elech veeshtachave nelech venishtachave hare ze mesit. hesit lishnayim hare hen edav vehen meviin oto levet din umeidin alav shekkach amar lahen vesoklin oto:

Veen hammesit tzarich hateraa. amar leechad hu omer yesh li chaverim rotzim bechach umaarim alav ad sheyyasit bifne shenayim kede lehargo. im lo ratza hammesit lehasit lishnayim mitzva lehachemin lo. kol chayyave mitot shebbattora en machminin alehen chutz mizze. ketzad machminin lo. hammusat mevi shenayim umaamidan bemakom afel kede sheyyiru hammesit veyishmeu devarav velo yire otam, vehu omer lammesit emor ma sheamarta li beyichud, vehu omer lo, vehammusat meshivo heach nanniach et elohenu shebbashshamayim venelech venaavod et haetzim veet haavanim. im chazar bo o shatak patur. veim amar lo kach hi chovatenu vechach yafe lanu, haomdim sham berachok meviin oto levet din vesoklim oto:

Mitzva beyad hammusat lehargo shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 10)</small> "yadcha tihye bo varishona lahamito" vegomer. veasur lammusat leehov et hammesit shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 9)</small> "lo tove lo". ulefi shenneemar besone <small>(Shemot 23 5)</small> "azov taazov immo" yachol atta ozev laze talmud lomar <small>(Devarim 13 9)</small> "velo tishma elav". ulefi shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 16)</small> "velo taamod al dam reecha" yachol i atta omed al damo shel ze talmud lomar <small>(Devarim 13 9)</small> "velo tachos encha". veasur lammusat lelammed alav zechut shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 9)</small> "velo tachml". veim yada lo chova eno rashshay lishtok mimmenna shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 9)</small> "velo techasse alav". veazhara lehedyot hammesit minnayin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 12)</small> "vechol yisrael yishmeu veyirau":

Hammesit acherim leavdo veamar lahem ivduni im avaduhu niskal veim lo avaduhu af al pi shekkibbelu mimmennu veamru hen eno niskal. aval im hesit laavodat ish acher o lishar mine avodat kochavim im kibbel mimmennu veamar hen nelech venaavod af al pi sheadayin lo avad shenehen niskalin hammesit vehammusat shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 9)</small> "lo tove lo velo tishma elav" ha im shama veava chayyav:

Navi hammitnabbe beshem avodat kochavim ketzad. ze haomer amra li avodat kochavim pelonit o kochav peloni shemmitzva laasot kach vechach o shello laasot, afillu kivven et hahalacha letamme et hattame uletaher et hattahor, im hitru bo bifne shenayim hare ze nechnak shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 20)</small> "vaasher yedabber beshem elohim acherim umet hannavi hahu". veazhara shello mikkelal shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 13)</small> "veshem elohim acherim lo tazkiru":

Veasur laaroch din uteshuva im hammitnabbe beshem avodat kochavim veen shoalin mimmennu ot umofet. veim asa meatzmo en mashgichin alav veen mehareharin bo. vechol hamechashshev beotot shello shemma emet hen over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 4)</small> "lo tishma el divre hannavi hahu". vechen nevi hashsheker mitato bechenek af al pi shennitnabbe beshem Adonai velo hosif velo gara shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 20)</small> "ach hannavi asher yazid ledabber davar bishmi et asher lo tzivviti" <small>(Devarim 18 20)</small> "umet hannavi hahu":
Echad hammitnabbe ma shello shama bemare hannevua o mi sheshshama divre navi chavero veamar sheddavar ze lo neemar vehu nitnabbe bo hare ze nevi sheker umitato bechenek:

Kol hammonea atzmo meharigat nevi hashsheker mippene maalato shehare holech bedarche hannevua hare ze over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 22)</small> "lo tagur mimmennu". vechen hammonea atzmo millelammed alav chova o happoched veyare middevarav hare hu bichlal lo tagur mimmennu. veen danin nevi hashsheker ella bevet din shel shivim veechad:

Hannoder beshem avodat kochavim vehannishba bah loke shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 13)</small> "veshem elohim acherim lo tazkiru". echad hannishba bah leatzmo veechad hannishba bah leoved kochavim. veasur lehashebia haoved kochavim beyirato. afillu lehazekir shem avodat kochavim shello derech shevua asur shenneemar lo tazkiru:

Lo yomar adam lachavero shemor li batztzad avodat kochavim pelonit vechayyotze bah. vechol avodat kochavim hakketuva bechitve hakkodesh muttar lehazekir shemah kegon peor uvel unevo vegad vechayyotze bahen. veasur ligrom laacherim sheyyidderu vesheyyekayyemu beshem avodat kochavim. veeno loke ella hannoder bishmah vehamekayyem bishmah vehu hannishba bishmah:

Haose ov o yiddeoni birtzono bezadon chayyav karet veim hayu sham edim vehateraa niskal. haya shogeg mevi chattat kevua. ketzad hu maase haov. ze shehu omed umaktir ketoret yedua veochez sharvit shel hadas beyado umenifo vehu medabber ballat bidvarim yeduim etzlam ad sheyyishma hashshoel keillu echad medabber immo umeshivo al ma shehu shoel bidvarim mittachat haaretz bekol namuch ad meod ucheillu eno nikkar laozen ella bemachashava margish bo. vechen hallokeach gulgolet hammet umaktir lah umenachesh bah ad sheyyishshama keillu kol yotze mittachat shechyo shafal ad meod umeshivo. kol ellu maase ov hen vehaose echad mehen niskal:

Ketzad maase hayyiddeoni. meniach etzem of sheshshemo yadua befiv umaktir veose maasim acherim ad sheyyippol kenichpe vidabber befiv devarim sheatidim lihyot. vechol ellu mine avodat kochavim hen veazhara shellahen minnayin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 lo)</small> "al tifnu el haovot" vegomer:

Hannoten mizzaro lammolech birtzono uvezadon chayyav karet. beshogeg mevi chattat kevua. veim asa beedim vehateraa niskal shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 20 2)</small> "asher yitten mizzaro lammolech mot yumat" vegomer. veazhara shello minnayin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 18 21)</small> "umizzaracha lo titten lehaavir lammlech" ulehallan hu omer <small>(Devarim 18 10)</small> "lo yimmatze vecha maavir beno uvitto baesh". ketzad hayu osim. madlik esh gedola velokeach miktzat zaro umosro lechohanehem ovde haesh. veotan hakkohanim notnin habben leaviv achar shennimsar beyadan lehaaviro baesh birshuto vaavi habben hu shemmaavir beno al haesh birshut hakkohanim umaaviro beraglav mitztzad ze letzad acher betoch hashshalhevet. lo shehu sorfo lammolech kederech shessorfin benehem uvenotehem laavodat kochavim acheret ella behaavara bilvad hayta avoda zo sheshshemah molech. lefichach haose avoda zo laavodat kochavim acheret chutz mimmolech patur:

Eno chayyav karet o sekila ad sheyyimsor beno lammolech veyaaviro beraglav baesh derech haavara. masar velo heevir heevir velo masar. o shemmasar veheevir shello bederech haavara patur. veeno chayyav ad sheyyimsor miktzat zaro veyaniach miktzat shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 20 3)</small> "ki mizzaro natan lammlech" miktzato velo kullo:

Echad zera kasher veechad zera pasul echad banav uvenotav benehem uvene benehem al kol yotze yerecho hu chayyav mippene shehen zaro. aval im heevir echav o achyotav o avotav o sheheevir atzmo patur. heevir echad mizzaro vehu yashen o shehaya suma patur:

Matztzeva sheasra tora hi binyan shehakkol mitkabbetzin etzlah vaafillu laavod et Adonai shekken haya derech ovde kochavim. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 22)</small> "velo takim lecha matztzeva". vechol hammekim matztzeva loke. vechen even maskit haamura battora af al pi shehu mishtachave aleha lashshem loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 26 1)</small> "veeven maskit lo tittenu beartzechem lehishtachavot aleha" mippene shehaya derech ovde kochavim lehanniach even lefaneha lehishtachavot aleha. lefichach en osin ken laAdonai. veeno loke ad sheyyifshot yadav veraglav al haeven venimtza kullo muttal aleha shezzo hi hishtachavaya haamura battora:

Bamme devarim amurim bishar (haaratzot) aval bammikdash muttar lehishtachavot al haavanim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 26 1)</small> "beartzechem", beartzechem i attem mishtachavim al haavanim aval attem mishtachavim al haavanim hamefutztzalot bammikdash. umippene ze nahagu kol yisrael lehatztzia machtzelaot bevatte kenesiyyot hartzufot baavanim o mine kash veteven lehavedil ben penehem uven haavanim. veim lo matza davar mavdil beno uven haeven holech lemakom acher umishtachave o shoche al tziddo umatte kede shello yadbik panav baeven:

Kol hammishtachave laAdonai al haavanim hamefutztzalot belo pishshut yadayim veraglayim eno loke ella makkin oto makkat mardut. aval laavodat kochavim echad hishtachavaya befishshut yadayim veraglayim o belo pishshut yadayim veraglayim mishshaa sheyyichbosh panav bakkarka niskal:

Hannotea ilan etzel hammizbeach o bechol haazara ben ilan serak ben ilan maachol af al pi sheasao lenoy lammikdash veyofi lo hare ze loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 21)</small> "lo titta lecha ashera kol etz etzel mizbach Adonai elohecha". mippene shehaya ze derech ovde kochavim notin ilanot betzad mizbeach shellah kede sheyyitkabbetzu sham haam:

Asur laasot achsadraot shel etz bammikdash kederech sheosin bachatzerot, af al pi shehu bevinyan veeno etz natua harechaka yetera hi shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 21)</small> "kol etz". ella kol haachsadraot vehassevachot hayyotzot min hakketalim shehayu bammikdash shel even hayu lo shel etz:

Mitzvat ase hi leabbed avodat kochavim umeshammesheha vechol hannaase bishvilah shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 2)</small> "abbed teabbedun et kol hammekomot" veneemar <small>(Devarim 7 5)</small> "ki im ko taasu lahem" vegomer. uveeretz yisrael mitzva lirdof achareha ad shenneabbed otah mikkol artzenu. aval bechutz laaretz en anu metzuvvin lirdof achareha ella kol makom shennichbosh oto neabbed kol avodat kochavim shebbo. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 3)</small> "veibbadtem et shemam min hammakom hahu". beeretz yisrael atta metzuvve lirdof acharehen vei atta metzuvve lirdof acharehen bechutz laaretz:

Avodat kochavim umeshammesheha vetikrovet shellah vechol hannaase bishvilah asur bahanaa shenneemar <small>(Devarim 7 26)</small> "velo tavi toeva el betecha" vechol hannehene beechad mikkol ellu loke shetayim. achat mishshum velo tavi. veachat mishshum velo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem:

Behema shehikrivuha kullah laavodat kochavim asura bahanaa afillu pirshah veatzmoteha vekarneha utelafeha veorah hakkol asur bahanaa. lefichach im haya baor siman sheyyodea bo shezze haor tikrovet avodat kochavim hu kegon shehayu osim shekkorim kera agol keneged hallev umotziin hallev hare kol otan haorot shehen kach asurin bahanaa vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Ma ben avodat kochavim shel oved kochavim laavodat kochavim shel yisrael. avodat kochavim shel oved kochavim asura bahanaa miyyad shenneemar <small>(Devarim 7 25)</small> "pesile elohehem tisrefun baesh" mishsheppesalo naasa lo eloah. veshel yisrael enah asura bahanaa ad shetteaved shenneemar <small>(Devarim 27 15)</small> "vesam bassater" ad sheyyaase lah devarim shebbasseter shehen avodatah. umeshammeshe avodat kochavim ben shel oved kochavim ben shel yisrael enan asurin ad sheyyishtammeshu bahen laavodat kochavim:

Haose avodat kochavim laacherim af al pi shehu loke secharo muttar vaafillu asaah leoved kochavim shehi asura miyyad. mippene sheenah neeseret ad shettiggamer umakkosh acharon sheggomrah en bo sheve peruta. hallokeach gerutaot min haoved kochavim umatza bahen avodat kochavim. im natan maot velo mashach yachazirem laoved kochavim. vechen im mashach velo natan maot af al pi shemmeshicha beoved kochavim kona kemekach taut hu. natan maot umashach yolichem leyam hammelach. vechen oved kochavim veger sheyyarshu et avihen oved kochavim yachol hagger lomar leoved kochavim tol atta avodat kochavim vaani maot. tol atta yen nesech vaani perot. veim mishshebbau lirshut hagger asur:

Tzurot sheasaum ovde kochavim lenoy muttarin bahanaa vetzurot sheasaum laavodat kochavim asurin. ketzad. kol hatztzurot hannimtzaim bakkefarim asurim bahanaa mippene shechezkatan shellaavodat kochavim hen asuyin, vehannimtzaot bammedina im hayu omdin al petach hammedina vehaya beyad hatztzura tzurat makkel o tzippor o kaddur o sayif o atara vetabbaat chezkato shehu laavodat kochavim veasur bahanaa. veim lav hare hu bechezkat lenoy umuttar:

Tzalme avodat kochavim hannimtzaim mushlachim bashshevakim o betoch haggerutaot hare ellu muttarin veen tzarich lomar shivre tzalmehen. aval hammotze yad mitztzurat kochav o mazzal o raglah o evar meevareha mushlach hare ze asur bahanaa hoil veyada bevadday shezze haevar min tzurat avodat kochavim hanneevedet hare hi beissurah ad sheyyivadda lo shehaovde kochavim ovdeha bitteluha:

Hammotze kelim vaalehen tzurat chamma ulevana uderakon. im hayu kele kesef vezahav o bigde shani o shehayu chakukim al hannezamim veal hattabbaot hare ellu asurin. veal shear hakkelim muttarin mippene shechezkatan lenoy. vechen shear hatztzurot hannimtzaot al kol hakkelim chezkatan lenoy umuttarin:

Avodat kochavim umeshammesheha vechol hattikrovet shellah osrim bechol shehen. ketzad. avodat kochavim shennitarva betzurot shel noy afillu achat bechamma alafim yolich hakkol leyam hammelach. vechen im nitarev kos shel avodat kochavim bechamma kosot o chaticha min habbasar (shennitarva) bechamma chatichot yolich hakkol leyam hammelach. vechen or lavuv shennitarev bechamma orot hakkol asur bahanaa. avar umachar avodat kochavim o echad mimmeshammesheha o tikrovet shellah hare haddamim asurin bahanaa veosrin bechol shehen kaavodat kochavim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 7 26)</small> "vehayita cherem kamohu" kol ma sheatta mevi meavodat kochavim umikkol meshammesheha vetikravtah hare hi kamoha:

Avodat kochavim o ashera shennisrefa efrah asur bahanaa. vegachelet shel avodat kochavim asura vehashshalhevet mutteret mippene sheen bah mammash. sefek avodat kochavim asur, sefek sefekah muttar. ketzad. kos shel avodat kochavim shennafal beotzar male kosot kullan asurim, mippene sheavodat kochavim vechol meshammesheha osrin bechol shehen. perash kos echad min hattaarovet venafal lechosot shenayim hare ellu muttarin. tabbaat shel avodat kochavim shennitarva bechamma tabbaot venaflu shetayim mehen layyam haggadol hutteru kullan sheani omer otah hattabbaat hayta bichlal hashshetayim. nitarva bemea venitchalleku arbaim lemakom echad veshishshim lemakom acher venaflu haarbaim kullan letabbaot acherot kullan muttarot sheani omer otah hattabbaat haasura barov hi. naflu hashshishshim letabbaot acherot kullan asurot:

Haashera ben shehayta neevedet ben shehayta avodat kochavim munnachat tachteha asur leshev betzel komatah. umuttar leshev betzel hassarigim vehealim shellah. veim yesh lo derech acheret asur lo laavor tachteha. veim en sham derech acheret over tachteha keshehu ratz:

Efrochim shekkinnenu bah veen tzerichin leimman muttarin. vehaefrochim vehabbetzim shetztzerichin leimman asurin shehare haashera kemo basis lahen. vehakken atzmah shebberoshah muttar mippene shehaof mevi etzav mimmakom acher:

Natal mimmenna etzim asurim bahanaa. hesik bahen et hattannur yutzan veachar kach yassik beetzim acherim shel hetter veyofe bo. afa bo et happat velo tzinneno happat asura bahanaa. nitarva baacherot yolich deme otah happat leyam hammelach kede shello yehane bah ushear hakkikkarot muttarin:

Natal mimmenna karkar vearag bo et habbeged asur bahanaa. nitarev bivgadim acherim yolich deme oto habbeged leyam hammelach ushear kol habbegadim muttarin. umuttar litta tachteha yerakot ben bimot hachamma shehen tzerichin letzel. ben bimot haggeshamim. mippene shetztzel haashera shehu asur im hakkarka sheenah neeseret gormin lirakot ellu litzmoach vechol sheddavar asur vedavar muttar gormin lo hare ze muttar bechol makom. lefichach sade shezzibbelah bezevel avodat kochavim muttar lizroa otah. ufara sheppittemah becharshine avodat kochavim teachel vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Basar o yayin o perot shehechinum lehakerivam laavodat kochavim lo neesru bahanaa af al pi shehichnisum levet avodat kochavim ad sheyyakrivum lefaneha. hikrivum lefaneha naasu tikrovet veaf al pi shechazru vehotzium hare ellu asurin leolam. vechol hannimtza bevet avodat kochavim afillu mayim umelach asur bahanaa min hattora. vehaochel mimmennu kol shehu loke:

Hammotze kesut vechelim umaot berosh avodat kochavim. im metzaan derech bizzayon hare ellu muttarin veim metzaan derech kavod hare ellu asurin. ketzad. matza kis taluy betzavvaro. kesut mekuppelet umunnachat al rosho. keli kafuy al rosho hare ze muttar mippene shehu derech bizzayon vechen kol kayyotze baze. matza berosho davar shekkayyotze bo karev legabbe hammizbeach hare ze asur. bamme devarim amurim bizman shemmetzaan chutz limkom avodato aval im metzao bifnim ben derech kavod ben derech bizzayon ben davar harauy lammizbeach ben davar sheeno rauy kol hannimtza bifnim asur afillu mayim umelach. ufeor umarkulis kol hannimtza immahen ben bifnim ben bachutz asur bahanaa. vechen avne markulis even hanniret shehi immo asur bahanaa:
Avodat kochavim shehaya lah merchatz o ginna nehenim bahem shello betova veen nehenim bahem betova. haya lah velaacherim nehenin bahen afillu betovat kohaneha uvilvad shello yitten sachar:

Merchatz sheyyesh bah avodat kochavim muttar lirchotz bah mippene shehi naaset sham lenoy velo leavdah. shenneemar elohehem. bizman shennohagim bah minhag elohut velo bizman shemmevazzin otan kegon zo shehi omedet al habbiv vehakkol mashtinin befaneha. veim hayta derech avodatah bechach asur likkanes bo:

Sakkin shel avodat kochavim sheshshachat bah hare ze muttar mippene shehu mekalkel. veim hayta behema mesukkenet hare zo asura mippene shehu metakken vahare ze hattikkun mehanaat meshammeshe avodat kochavim. vechen asur lachtoch bah basar mippene shehu metakken veim chatach derech hefsed vehashechata muttar:

Kol sheen bo tefisat yad adam velo asahu adam af al pi shenneevad hare ze muttar bahanaa. lefichach ovde kochavim haovdim et heharim veet haggevaot veet hailanot hannetuin mittechillatan leferot veet hammayanot hannovin larabbim veet habbehema hare ellu muttarin bahanaa umuttar leechol otan happerot shenneevdu bimkom gedilatan veotah habbehema. veen tzarich lomar habbehema shehuktzat laavodat kochavim shehi mutteret baachila ben shehiktzuha leavdah ben shehiktzuha lehakerivah hare zo mutteret. bamme devarim amurim sheen habbehema neeseret beshello asa bah maase leshem avodat kochavim aval asa bah maase kol shehu asarah. ketzad, kegon sheshshachat bah siman laavodat kochavim. asaah chalifin laavodat kochavim asarah. vechen chalife chalifin. mippene shennaasim deme avodat kochavim. bamme devarim amurim bevehemat atzmo. aval im shachat behemat chavero laavodat kochavim o hechelifah lo neesra sheen adam oser davar sheeno shello. hammishtachave lekarka olam lo asarah. chafar bah borot shichin umearot leshem avodat kochavim asarah:
Mayim sheakaran haggal vehishtachava lahen lo asaran. netalan beyado vehishtachava lahen asaran. avne har shenniddaldelu vaavadan bimkomam muttarot shehare en bahen tefisat yad adam:

Yisrael shezzakaf levena lehishtachavot lah velo hishtachava lah uva oved kochavim vehishtachava lah asarah bahanaa shezzekifatah maase. vechen im zakaf betza uva oved kochavim vehishtachava lah asarah. chatach delaat vechayyotze bah vehishtachava lah asarah. hishtachava lachatzi delaat vachatzi haacher meore bo hare ze asur missafek shemma ze hachetzi kemo yad lachetzi hanneevad. ilan shennetao mittechilla sheyyihye neevad asur bahanaa vezo hi ashera haamura battora. haya ilan natua ugedao ufesalo leshem avodat kochavim afillu hivrich vehirkiv begufo shel ilan vehotzi sarigim koret et hassarigim vehem asurim bahanaa ushear hailan muttar. vechen hammishtachave leilan af al pi shello neesar gufo kol hassarigim vehealim vehallulavin vehapperot sheyyotzi kol zeman shehu neevad hare ellu asurin bahanaa. ilan shehayu haovde kochavim meshammerin et perotav veomrim shehem muchanim laasot shechar levet avodat kochavim peloni veosin mehen shechar veshotim oto beyom chaggam hare ze hailan asur bahanaa mippene shessetamo shehu ashera ulefichach osin beferotav kach shezzo hi chukkah shel ashera:
